title: General Accountant (Full-Cycle Accounting | US, AU & SG Experience Preferred)
description:
We are seeking an experienced General Accountant to support international clients across the United States, Australia, and Singapore.



This is a remote Independent Contractor opportunity for accounting professionals with strong full-cycle accounting experience who can confidently manage General Ledger activities, month-end close, financial reporting, reconciliations, and AP/AR processes.



We are looking for individuals who are proactive, detail-oriented, accountable, and comfortable working in fast-paced, multi-entity business environments.



Responsibilities



General Ledger & Month-End Close

• Maintain accurate General Ledger (GL) records and account reconciliations

• Prepare journal entries, accruals, prepaids, and other accounting adjustments

• Perform bank, balance sheet, and intercompany reconciliations

• Support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close processes

• Maintain supporting schedules and accounting documentation



Accounts Payable & Accounts Receivable

• Process vendor invoices and payments

• Manage AP aging and vendor accounts

• Generate and issue customer invoices

• Monitor collections and customer balances

• Resolve billing, payment, and account discrepancies

• Track and reconcile incoming payments



Financial Reporting & Analysis

• Prepare financial reports and supporting schedules

• Assist with variance analysis and management reporting

• Support budgeting and forecasting activities

• Assist with audit requests and financial documentation



Accounting Operations

• Support multi-entity and multi-currency accounting activities

• Coordinate with internal teams and external stakeholders

• Assist with accounting system maintenance and process improvements

• Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, accuracy, and internal controls

• Support special projects and other accounting initiatives as needed



Requirements

• Bachelor's Degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field

• Minimum 3 years of accounting experience

• Strong end-to-end accounting background

• Experience with month-end close and reconciliations

• Experience with AP and AR processes

• Advanced Excel skills

• Experience using accounting or ERP systems

• Strong communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills

• Ability to work independently and manage deadlines



Preferred Qualifications

• Experience supporting US, Australian, or Singapore-based companies

• Multi-entity or multi-currency accounting experience

• Shared Services or BPO accounting experience

• Experience with NetSuite, SAP, Oracle, QuickBooks, Xero, Workday, or similar platforms

• CPA designation or equivalent certification



Work Setup

• Fully Remote

• Independent Contractor

• Full-Time Availability Preferred



Application Instructions



Please submit:

• Updated Resume/CV

• Expected Monthly Compensation

• List of accounting systems/ERP platforms used



At the top of your application, please answer:

How many years of accounting experience do you have?

Which countries have you supported?

Which accounting/ERP systems have you used?

Have you handled month-end close independently?

What is your expected monthly compensation?



Subject Line:

GenAcct – YOUR FULL NAME



Only qualified applicants will be contacted.

# Remote Inside Sales + Customer Service | Inbound & Outbound | Commission + Bonuses



## ARE YOU THE TYPE OF PERSON WHO LIKES A CHALLENGE?



Are you a leader?



Can you actively listen, think quickly, and confidently communicate with people?



Are you hungry to grow professionally and financially?



Are you into self-development and constantly trying to become better?



Do you want to join a smaller entrepreneurial company where you can make a real impact — instead of becoming another number inside a massive corporation?



**Keep reading.**



We're a rapidly growing **commercial and residential maid & janitorial services company** serving the Phoenix, Arizona market.



But Phoenix is only the beginning.



Our goal is to build an **eight-figure cleaning company and expand into additional major metropolitan markets throughout the United States.**



We're looking for exceptional, long-term team members who want to grow with us, take on increasing responsibility, and potentially become future leaders within the company.



## THE ROLE



This is a remote **Inside Sales + Customer Service** position combining:



**Inbound Sales + Outbound Sales + Customer Service + Job Coordination**



When leads come in, your job is to respond FAST, understand what the customer needs, build rapport, provide pricing, handle objections, follow up, and **close the sale.**



When inbound activity slows down, you don't sit around waiting for the phone to ring.



**You create opportunities.**



That means:



* Cold calling

* Cold

* Social media outreach

* Direct messaging prospects

* Commercial prospecting

* Following up with old leads

* Re-engaging previous customers

* Working CRM opportunities

* Building referral relationships

* Finding new ways to start sales conversations



**Downtime = pipeline-building time.**



The objective isn't meaningless activity.



It's:



**Conversations → Opportunities → Bookings → Revenue → Recurring Customers**



## WHAT YOU'LL DO



You'll be responsible for:



* Handling inbound calls, texts, and leads

* Responding rapidly to new opportunities

* Qualifying prospective customers

* Providing quotes

* Handling objections

* Following up consistently

* Closing and booking jobs

* Selling recurring cleaning services

* Conducting outbound prospecting

* Cold calling and cold
ing

* Social media outreach

* Commercial business development

* Communicating with existing customers

* Helping coordinate jobs with operations

* Maintaining accurate CRM records

* Following our sales processes, scripts, and SOPs



We want someone who can **close opportunities when they arrive and create opportunities when they don't.**



## WHO WE WANT



We're looking for people who are:



**HAPPY. HUNGRY. HUMBLE. SMART.**



And by smart, we mean **sharp as a tack.**



You communicate exceptionally well.



You listen.



You notice details.



You learn quickly.



You take ownership.



You don't need constant supervision.



You can handle rejection.



You accept coaching.



You solve problems instead of making excuses.



And you want to **win.**



If you're looking for an easy remote job where you can disappear between tasks, this isn't it.



If you're looking for an opportunity to **develop your skills, produce results, increase your income, and potentially grow into leadership**, we'd like to meet you.



## GOHIGHLEVEL + TECHNOLOGY



We use **GoHighLevel (GHL)** as our CRM.



Previous GoHighLevel experience is strongly preferred.



You should be comfortable with:



* CRM pipelines

* Calls

* Lead follow-up

title: Basic Headline Editor
description:
Basic Headline Editor

Exchange Life · Fully Remote · Full-Time Contractor · ~40 hrs/week $5 USD/hour + $300–$800/month in performance bonuses

About Exchange Life

Exchange Life is a fast-growing e-commerce travel jewelry brand. We sell collectible country charms for travelers, with new product lines launching soon. Our content team of editors, filmmakers, and creators works fully remotely across the world.

This role is a starting point, and we're straight about that — it's focused work editing headline videos to a proven format. But it's a starting point on a team that promotes from the inside. Many of our editors have been with us two or more years, and the ones who started here are now the people briefing everyone else.

Where You'll Be in Six Months

AI Advanced Editor.

That's the next title, and it's the step most of our strong headline editors make inside their first six months. An AI Advanced Editor works on our highest-leverage creative: AI-assisted video, hook development, and the ad formats we scale behind. You stop working purely to a template and start building the ones other people follow.

It's d
 by performance, not tenure. Produce winners consistently and you'll get there sooner.

What You'll Earn

Base: $5 USD/hour

Performance bonuses: $300–$800/month, paid per winning creative — when a video you cut hits our performance thresholds or scales on paid, you get paid for it

There's no cap on how good your month can be

What Success Looks Like

Within three to six months, you're consistently producing headline videos that perform on both paid and organic channels — 50%+ thumb-stop rates and 30%+ hold rates — and iterating on winning formats without needing day-to-day direction.

Responsibilities

Edit TikTok and Reels headline content optimized for hook rate, retention, and watch time

Review past edits daily, identify what is and isn't working, and apply those lessons

Work with the marketing team to test new creative angles and iterate on proven formats

Turn work around quickly and communicate proactively each day

Track TikTok and Instagram trends and apply them where relevant

Requirements

A recent portfolio of short-form edits (ideally 20+ from the past few months)

Ability to break down why a viral video or high-performing ad worked

Comfortable reading performance metrics (hook rate, retention, watch time) and adjusting accordingly

Skilled in CapCut Pro or a comparable editing tool

Strong written and spoken English, and the ability to work independently

Takes ownership and applies feedback consistently

Preferred

Experience editing for e-commerce brands

Exposure to AI video tools, talking heads, or voiceover formats

Experience interpreting paid ad metrics

What You'll Learn Here

Most editing roles teach you software. This one teaches you why things sell. You'll get direct access to paid ad data on real spend, see which of your creatives print money and which die, and build the one skill that makes editors expensive: knowing what to make before you make it.

Access to courses and paid software

1-on-1 mentorship from our Content Lead

Full visibility into TikTok and Meta performance data on your own work

Not a Fit If

Your portfolio is mostly long-form, YouTube, or event/wedding content

You prefer a fixed schedule or close day-to-day supervision

You're looking for a short-term project or side gig

Working Style

Independent contractor engagement, paid in USD

100% remote, approximately 40 hours per week, long-term

Flexible schedule with no required timezone overlap — async communication daily

Flexible paid time off, coordinated with the team

Tools: CapCut Pro (or comparable), TikTok and Meta analytics

No micromanagement

How to Apply

Applications take about five minutes. We review every submission.



APPLY HERE:

We are looking for someone who is highly organized, proactive, detail-oriented, and experienced in building scalable systems inside a fast-moving DTC or performance marketing environment.



Key Responsibilities



- Manage the end-to-end workflow across performance creative, UGC production, advertorials, listicles, landing pages, PDPs, offer tests, and retention initiatives.

- Translate creative, CRO, and retention roadmaps into clear sprint plans with owners, priorities, dependencies, timelines, and deliverables.

- Coordinate between Creative Strategists, media buyers, copywriters, editors, designers, creators, CRO specialists, funnel builders, and retention partners.

- Ensure briefs and production requirements are complete before work begins, including formats, references, deliverables, deadlines, tracking requirements, and approval ownership.

- Manage creative and funnel timelines, production capacity, feedback, revisions, QA, approvals, asset organization, and launch readiness.

- Ensure that media-buying and conversion results are documented and fed back into creative, funnel, and retention planning for the next testing cycle.

- Build and continuously improve SOPs, ClickUp/Notion boards, trackers, dashboards, naming conventions, reporting systems, and team workflows.

- Identify bottlenecks, missed handoffs, unclear ownership, and repeated rework, then proactively improve the underlying process.

- Maintain clear accountability across the team and provide concise weekly updates covering what shipped, what is in progress, what is blocked, and what requires a decision.

- Help the team increase output and speed without sacrificing strategic quality or production standards.



Requirements



- 2+ years of experience in Creative Operations, Growth Operations, Creative Project Management, or Production Management.

- Direct experience working with DTC ecommerce brands, performance marketing teams, or direct-response creative agencies.

- Experience coordinating cross-functional teams involving Creative Strategists, media buyers, copywriters, video editors, designers, creators, CRO specialists, funnel builders, or retention teams.

- Strong understanding of the performance creative lifecycle, from research and briefs through production, launch, performance analysis, iteration, and learning documentation.

- Familiarity with direct-response funnels, including advertorials, listicles, pre-landers, landing pages, PDPs, offer testing, upsells, and conversion-focused copy.

- Demonstrated experience building SOPs, production systems, capacity trackers, approval workflows, and operational processes from scratch.

- Strong project management skills across multiple SKUs, campaigns, and concurrent workstreams.

- Highly organized, detail-oriented, reliable, and proactive, with strong ownership and follow-through.

- Comfortable working directly with founders and senior functional leads while maintaining clear responsibility across the wider team.

- Proficiency with ClickUp, Notion, Asana, Slack, Google Workspace, or similar project-management and documentation tools.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Availability for substantial working-hour overlap with the Asia-based team.



Why Join Us



- Long-term opportunity with the potential to transition into a full-time contractor role.

- High ownership and direct impact on how the creative and growth organization is built.

- Work directly with the founder and senior specialists across various teams

- Opportunity to build the operating system behind a fast-growing DTC brand



How to apply



Please apply with:



- Your CV/LinkedIn and current availability



- Examples of DTC/ecommerce brands or teams you have supported



- Your expected monthly salary



- Share one real example where you personally managed a creative or growth workflow across strategy, production, launch and performance review. What was the bottleneck, what system or process did you introduce, and what improved as a result?



- What tools have you used to manage creative production and performance learnings (e.g. ClickUp, Notion, Airtable), and what was your exact responsibility within the team?

title: Real Estate Pricing Analyst
description:
About Us:

Mega Land Pros is a leading real estate investment firm that is focused on acquiring and managing real estate assets. Our highly experienced team specializes in identifying opportunities, closing transactions efficiently, and delivering exceptional results.



Job Description:

We are seeking a detail-oriented individual to join our team as a Real Estate Pricing Analyst. This role will be critical in acquiring and evaluating land deals, analyzing comparable properties, researching markets, and gathering data..



This is a long-term, full-time position. You will be working directly with our U.S. team during eastern business hours.



Responsibilities:



- Research and evaluate vacant land properties as they come into our pipeline

- Search and analyze comparable land sales to determine market value

- Create accurate offer ranges and maximum allowable offer (MAO) to buy profitably

- Assess deal spreads, margins, and risk

- Review the property details such as size, topography, flood zones, access, utilities, etc.

- Set follow up tasks and notes in Salesforce for our Acquisitions Manager

- Market analysis and research

- Scrub and clean data

- Price properties using guidelines

- Format excel spreadsheets for direct mail campaigns

- Coordinate with title companies, buyers, sellers, and attorneys

- Create and follow SOPs and checklists

- Communicate clearly and effectively with the team

- Perform due diligence tasks such as ordering photography, land surveys, soil tests, calling utility companies and counties

- Miscellaneous real estate-based tasks



Qualifications:



- Experience with real estate, specifically vacant land and land pricing

- Strong analytical and research skills (Google Maps, Zillow, Redfin, LandID, County GIS, etc.)

- High attention to detail and accuracy in reporting

- Strong spoken English with minimal accent to communicate effectively with US-based clients

- High energy with excellent communication and interpersonal skills

- Takes full ownership

- Follows checklists

- Meets deadlines

- Communicate clearly

- Ability to learn and work independently

- Proficient in Excel

- Dependable internet connection and a quiet work environment



Soft Skills needed:



- Strong and fluent in speaking and writing English

- Detail orientated

- Kind and empathetic



Working Hours:



Must be available between 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM Eastern Time

No other jobs are to be worked during this time. Working another job will result in immediate dismissal.



Pay:



- Base Salary between $4/hr-$6/hr (depending on experience)

- Performance-based cash bonus

- On-time payments



How to Apply:



Record a 3-5 minute Loom video with an introduction of yourself, then answer the following questions:



1. What is your experience in real estate or land pricing?

2. How would you price per acre for a 5 acre property in a rural area?

3. What experience do you have with processing direct mail campaigns?

4. What tools have you used and how do you research land parcels?

.

title: AI Operations & Automation Manager — Process Audit + AI Agents
description:
AI Operations & Automation Manager



We are a U.S. immigration law firm looking for an experienced AI Operations & Automation Manager who can independently audit our current workflows, identify bottlenecks and inefficiencies, redesign and document our processes, and then personally build AI automations and AI agents to improve the way the firm operates.



This is not just an automation developer role and not just a traditional Operations Manager role. We need someone who can understand how a business actually operates first, then determine what should be improved, standardized, automated, or handled by AI.



Initial Focus



Our first priority will be auditing our case-preparation workflow from the time a client hires us through attorney review and filing.



Much of this process is currently managed by a small team, and we want greater visibility into:



how work is actually being completed

how cases are prioritized

where cases are delayed or stalled

staff responsibilities and handoffs

unnecessary manual or duplicate work

processes that currently depend on individual employee knowledge

opportunities for AI and automation



You will interview team members, observe existing workflows, map the current process, identify bottlenecks, and recommend a better future-state workflow before implementing automation.



Responsibilities

Conduct operational and workflow audits

Interview employees and independently map how work actually happens

Identify bottlenecks, duplicate work, unnecessary steps, and unclear ownership

Create current-state and future-state process maps

Develop clear SOPs and process documentation

Define responsibilities, handoffs, triggers, and escalation points

Design and personally build workflow automations

Build and deploy AI agents for appropriate business processes

Integrate AI with existing systems using APIs and webhooks

Create dashboards and reporting that improve owner visibility

Build human-in-the-loop workflows for sensitive or higher-risk tasks

Document all systems so the business is not dependent on one employee or developer

Continuously identify opportunities to improve efficiency and scalability

Required Experience



We are specifically looking for someone with hands-on experience in both operations/process improvement AND AI automation.



Strong experience with several of the following is preferred:



ChatGPT / OpenAI / OpenAI API

Claude / Anthropic API

AI agents / agentic workflows

n8n

Make

Zapier

APIs and webhooks

RAG / AI knowledge bases

AI document processing

CRM and workflow integrations

SOP creation

Process mapping

Business process improvement

Workflow redesign

Operations management

What We Are NOT Looking For



We are not looking for someone who:



only uses ChatGPT for prompting or content creation

only builds basic Zapier automations

requires us to fully design the workflow before they can build anything

only manages employees without technical automation skills



We need someone who can independently discover the process, improve the process, and then build the technology around it.



To Apply



Please answer these three questions:



Describe one business workflow you personally audited and redesigned where the process was not already clearly documented for you. How did you discover the real workflow, and what did you change?

Describe 1–2 AI agents you personally built and deployed in a real business. What did the agents do, and what tools/models did you use?

For those projects, what did you personally build versus work completed by another developer or team?



Please include links to your portfolio, GitHub, case studies, Loom videos, or examples of systems you have personally built, if available.



Schedule



This may begin as a project focused on the operational audit and redesign, with the potential to develop into a longer-term role depending on fit and results.



Experience working with U.S. professional-services businesses or law firms is a plus, but not required.

title: NDIS rostering coordinator
description:
## Job Title



NDIS Rostering Coordinator — Disability Support & Workforce Scheduling



## Role Type



Remote / Offshore

Full-time

Australian healthcare and disability support business



## About the Role



We are looking for a highly organised and proactive NDIS Rostering Coordinator to support the day-to-day scheduling of disability support workers and client services across our growing Australian NDIS and care services business.



This role is ideal for someone with experience in rostering, scheduling, workforce coordination, disability support administration, healthcare administration or virtual operations support.



You will help ensure clients receive the right support, at the right time, with the right staff member. The role requires strong attention to detail, clear communication, fast follow-up and the ability to manage changes in a busy service environment.



You will work closely with care managers, support workers and management to coordinate shifts, update rosters, track staff availability, manage changes and maintain accurate records.



## Key Responsibilities



### Rostering & Scheduling



Create, update and maintain staff rosters



Allocate support workers to client shifts based on availability, location, skills and client needs



Monitor upcoming shifts and identify gaps or coverage issues



Assist with last-minute roster changes, cancellations and staff replacements



Update shift details accurately in the rostering system



Ensure rosters are communicated clearly to support workers and relevant managers



### Staff & Client Coordination



Communicate with support workers regarding shift confirmations, changes and availability



Follow up with staff who have not confirmed shifts or submitted required information



Support care managers with client scheduling needs



Escalate urgent issues, missed shifts, complaints or service risks to management



Help ensure clients receive consistent and reliable support



Maintain professional communication with staff, clients and internal teams



### Compliance & Administration



Maintain accurate records of shifts, staff availability and service changes



Assist with tracking staff documents, training, qualifications and compliance requirements



Support incident, cancellation and shift note follow-ups where required



Assist with timesheet checks and roster accuracy before payroll or invoicing



Help maintain clean and organised client and staff records



### Systems & Reporting



Use rostering, CRM, spreadsheet or care management systems to manage information



Prepare simple reports on roster gaps, staff availability, unfilled shifts or service issues



Keep trackers updated and accurate



Identify process improvements to make rostering more efficient



Support management with general operations tasks as required



## What We Are Looking For



Strong written and verbal English communication



Experience in rostering, scheduling, workforce coordination, healthcare administration or virtual assistance



Highly organised and detail-focused



Able to work quickly and calmly when roster changes occur



Confident communicating with staff and managers



Able to follow instructions and escalate issues appropriately



Comfortable using spreadsheets,
, online systems and shared folders



Reliable, proactive and able to work independently



Strong follow-up skills and ability to manage competing priorities



Trustworthy with confidential client and staff information



## Preferred Experience



Previous experience in NDIS, disability support, aged care, healthcare or home care rostering



Experience using ShiftCare, Brevity, CareMaster, Deputy, Employment Hero, Visualcare, Lumary or similar systems



Experience working with Australian businesses or clients



Understanding of support worker scheduling, client preferences and continuity of care



Experience with timesheets, shift notes, cancellations and service delivery administration



Experience working remotely with distributed teams



## What Success Looks Like



In the first 30 days, you will understand our clients, support workers, systems, rostering process and communication standards.



In the first 60 days, you will be confidently updating rosters, confirming shifts, managing staff availability, identifying gaps and supporting care managers with scheduling needs.



In the first 90 days, you will be helping improve rostering accuracy, reduce missed shifts, strengthen communication and create smoother workforce coordination across the business.



## Why Join Us



You will be joining a growing Australian healthcare and disability support business with a strong focus on quality service delivery, responsiveness and operational improvement.



This is a long-term opportunity for someone who wants to grow in NDIS operations, rostering, workforce coordination or care administration.



You will work closely with business owners, care managers and operations teams, and play an important role in making sure clients receive reliable and consistent support.



## How to Apply



Please send your resume and a short message outlining:



Your rostering, scheduling or workforce coordination experience



Any NDIS, aged care, disability support or healthcare experience



Systems you have used, especially ShiftCare or similar rostering platforms



Your remote work experience



Your expected monthly salary



Your availability to start

title: SENIOR PYTHON / AI AGENT ENGINEER
description:
Senior Python AI Agent Developer (LangGraph, RAG, pgvector)

 

TYPE OF WORK: Full Time

SALARY: $
USD per month, based on demonstrated experience

HOURS PER WEEK: 40-50

 

BEFORE YOU APPLY

 

Put your one-paragraph answer to Question 1 at the very top of your message. Applications that do not start with that answer are deleted unread. We are not being difficult, we just get a lot of copy-paste applications and this is the fastest way to find the people who actually do this work.

 

 

ABOUT HEARTSTAMP

 

HeartStamp is a US AI-native greeting card platform. People create a one-of-a-kind card with us and we print and mail it to the door, or deliver it as an animated digital card. We launched in the US in 2026 and we are shipping fast. We are a small distributed team and every engineer owns a real part of the product.

 

 THE ROLE

 

We are hiring a Senior Python AI Agent Developer to work on Stampy, our conversational card assistant, with a clear path to owning it end to end.

 

Stampy is not a simple chatbot. It is a stateful, tool-using agent that understands what a customer wants, searches a live catalogue of tens of thousands of cards, drives image generation, and hands off into a print-ready pipeline. It is the product.

 

The hard part of this job is not getting a model to answer. It is making the answer reliable. Did the captured intent survive the handoff. Did the right tool get called with the right value. Does the flow recover when the model drifts. Can you prove any of it with an evaluation suite instead of guessing. If you have shipped agents to real users, you already know that the failures that hurt are the confident wrong answers, not the crashes.

 

You will work directly with our Tech Lead and Principal Engineer, and you will own decisions, not just tickets.

  

THE HARD PART

 

Read this section carefully. It is the real job and it is what we will talk about if we speak.

 

A conversational agent and a product catalogue speak different languages. The agent can express far more than any storefront has pages for, and the translation between those two vocabularies is where agent products quietly break. Not with errors. With plausible answers that are wrong.

 

The layer that turns what a customer means into catalogue state, and keeps both vocabularies honest with each other, is the highest-value thing you will own here. Getting it right is mostly not a model problem. It is a contract problem, a state problem, and an evaluation problem.

 

If that sounds interesting rather than tedious, we should talk.

 

 WHAT YOU WILL DO

 

The agent layer

- Build and maintain stateful, tool-using LLM workflows in LangChain and LangGraph: structured outputs, routing, checkpoints and memory, approval gates, multi-step flows.

- Own the deterministic layer around the model: reliable slot and state capture, stage gating, guarding tool calls, and graceful recovery when the model goes off track.

- Integrate multiple LLM providers (OpenAI, Google Gemini, Vertex AI, OpenRouter, xAI) with model selection, prompt versioning, rate limit handling and fallbacks. We are model agnostic on purpose.

- Manage interactive performance: per-turn latency budgets, response streaming, prompt caching, model routing for sub-tasks, and cost versus speed trade-offs.

 

Retrieval

- Build and tune our RAG pipeline on pgvector: embeddings, HNSW indexing, chunking and metadata design, hybrid retrieval, ranking, relevance tuning, and fallback strategies.

- Retrieval that serves a real catalogue with real inventory, not a document question and answer demo.

 

The resolution layer

- The mapping between conversational intent and catalogue state: occasion slugs, recipient and filter tokens, style tokens, and the routes they resolve to.

- Keeping the agent's vocabulary and the storefront's vocabulary in sync, as a checked contract rather than a runtime guess.

- Round-trip guarantees: if we put a value in a URL, reading it back gives you the choice that produced it.

 

Proving it works

- pytest, async tests, mocked external services, and agent evaluation suites.

- Golden datasets, automated behavioral tests, retrieval metrics, LLM-as-a-judge, and production feedback loops.

- Structured logging, tracing, error monitoring, and LLM tracing with LangSmith.

 

You will also work in

- FastAPI: async APIs, Pydantic, REST design, auth, error handling, integration tests.

- PostgreSQL with SQLAlchemy or SQLModel, and query performance.

- Celery and Redis for background AI pipelines: retries, idempotency, backfills, long-running jobs. We have people who own the infrastructure, so you do not need to be deep here, but you need to be comfortable.

 

 REQUIREMENTS

 

- At least 5 years of professional Python engineering, including owning production services.

- At least 2 years building LLM features, agent workflows, semantic search, or RAG systems that real customers used.

- Real experience shipping retrieval on PostgreSQL and pgvector, not only prototype chatbots.

- Solid FastAPI experience inside a distributed system of APIs, workers, queues and third party services.

- Experience evaluating AI output quality using golden datasets, behavioral tests, retrieval metrics, or LLM-as-a-judge.

- Good judgment on reliability: provider outages, model failures, retries, graceful degradation, and feature-flagged rollouts.

- Comfortable with Docker, CI/CD, and AWS.

- Strong written English. You will be arguing about architecture in Slack with senior engineers and writing design notes people act on.

- Able to overlap at least 4 hours daily with 9am to 5pm US Eastern Time. This is required, not preferred.

 

 NICE TO HAVE

 

- Enough TypeScript to follow a bug across the boundary. Some of our worst defects live half in Python and half in the frontend filter state. You do not need to be a React developer, but you need to be able to read it.

- Multimodal AI, especially image generation or image understanding pipelines. Strongly preferred.

- DeepEval, LangSmith evaluations, Sentry, or PostHog.

- S3-compatible storage, image moderation, or content safety.

- A consumer product where AI output directly drives a purchase or a creative result.

 

 WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT

 

- Not a prompt writing role. We already have a prompt engineer and a card library team.

- Not a research role. What you build ships to customers this quarter.

- Not a rebuild from scratch. The platform is live. You are strengthening and extending it.

- Not an infrastructure role. We have a DevOps engineer and a principal engineer who own that.

 

 SCREENING QUESTIONS

 

Short and specific beats long and general. Applications without answers will not be reviewed.

 

1. An agent captures the user's intent correctly, the value is present and correct in the request, and the user still gets the wrong result. Nothing errors and all tests pass. How do you find this, and what check do you add so it cannot happen again?

 

2. Describe an evaluation suite you built for an agent or retrieval system. What did it assert, how often did it run, and what did it catch that a unit test would not?

 

3. You have a multi-step conversation where the model sometimes skips a required step. How do you make it reliable without making it feel scripted?

 

4. Describe a retrieval system you shipped on PostgreSQL and pgvector. What was the corpus, how did you chunk it, and how did you know the ranking was good?

 

5. What are your current working hours, and what overlap can you commit to with 9am to 5pm US Eastern?

 

 HOW TO APPLY

 

Answer to Question 1 at the very top of your message. Then your resume, a link to production work you can talk about in detail, and your answers to the rest.

 

We review daily and move fast. Strong candidates get a short paid trial task: a small, self-contained problem drawn from the kind of work you would actually be doing. About two hours, paid at your rate, and it is the closest thing to the actual job we can show you before we commit.

title: CREDIT DISPUTE SPECIALIST — REMOTE
description:
We are looking for an experienced Credit Dispute Specialist to join our growing team.



This is NOT an entry-level position. We are looking for someone who already understands the credit dispute process and can step into an established workflow without requiring extensive training on the fundamentals.

We will train you on our company's specific processes and SOPs, but you should already have a strong understanding of credit disputes and be comfortable working independently.



POSITION DETAILS

* Starting Rate: $5/HR

* Trial Period: Paid trial

* Work Environment: 100% Remote

* Long-Term Opportunity: Consistent ongoing client files available for candidates who successfully complete the trial

* Growth Opportunity: We are building and expanding our dispute team, so there is room for increased responsibility as the company grows



This is a production-based role rather than an hourly position. Compensation is paid per client file/round completed accurately according to our SOPs and documentation requirements.



YOU MUST ALREADY HAVE EXPERIENCE WITH:

* DisputeFox

* CFPB complaints/disputes

* FTC reports/processes

* Experian backdoor methods/processes

* Credit report analysis

* Client documentation review

* Identity theft and factual dispute workflows

* Bureau dispute submissions

* Managing multiple client files simultaneously

* GoHighLevel or similar CRM systems



You should understand how to review a client's credit profile, identify inaccuracies and inconsistencies, determine the appropriate dispute strategy, properly document your work, and move files through the dispute process efficiently.



We will train you on how WE do things. We will not be training you on the fundamentals of credit disputes.



WE ARE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO:

* Is highly organized and detail-oriented

* Follows SOPs and instructions exactly

* Understands dispute strategy—not just how to generate letters

* Can manage multiple client files without becoming disorganized

* Works efficiently without sacrificing accuracy

* Can work independently without constant supervision

* Communicates professionally with team members

* Takes accountability and ownership of their work

* Can receive feedback and make corrections quickly

* Does not require heavy training on basic credit dispute processes

* Is proactive and solution-oriented, not someone who simply waits for instructions

* Pays attention to patterns and results across client files and communicates what they notice

* Speaks up when something isn't working and comes prepared with possible solutions

* Recognizes what IS working and looks for opportunities to improve or build on it

* Thinks beyond simply completing the assigned task and looks for ways to improve results, efficiency, and processes



We value team members who think critically. If you notice a recurring issue, an opportunity to improve a process, or a strategy that appears to be producing strong results, we want you to speak up.



PRODUCTIVITY EXPECTATIONS



This is a production-based role.



As you become familiar with our internal processes, an initial benchmark will be approximately 5–8 completed client files/rounds per full working day, depending on file complexity and assigned workload.

Quality and accuracy come first. We are not looking for someone who rushes through client files simply to increase their completed-file count.



Your work will be evaluated based on:

* Accuracy and quality

* Dispute strategy

* Efficiency

* Ability to follow SOPs

* Organization and documentation

* Communication

* Reliability

* Initiative and problem-solving

* Overall client-file output



PAID TRIAL & TRAINING PROCESS

Candidates selected after the interview will begin with a paid trial period.

We will first walk you through our internal workflow and show you exactly how we expect client files to be handled.



You will then be assigned client files to complete using our process. During your initial trial files, your work will be reviewed at specific checkpoints before final submissions are made.



This may include review of:

* Dispute letters

* FTC documentation

* CFPB complaints

* File documentation

* Submission confirmations/screenshots



As you demonstrate accuracy, consistency, and a strong understanding of our process, you will be expected to complete files more independently with less supervision.



The purpose of the trial is to evaluate your actual ability to perform the work, follow our processes, think critically, accept feedback, communicate effectively, and consistently produce accurate client files.

Candidates who successfully complete the trial may be offered consistent ongoing work with our dispute team.



HOW TO APPLY



Please submit ALL of the following:



1. Your resume

2. A 2–3 minute Loom/video introducing yourself and briefly explaining:

* Your previous credit dispute experience

* How long you've worked with DisputeFox

* Approximately how many client files you have managed at one time

* Your experience with CFPB and FTC processes

* Your general dispute workflow/process

3. Blurred/redacted screenshots demonstrating your experience inside relevant systems/platforms.

Do NOT include client names, Social Security numbers, dates of birth, addresses, account numbers, credit report information, or any other sensitive client information.

4. Answer the following scenario:

“You receive a new client file containing collections, charge-offs, late payments, and inconsistent personal information across the three credit bureaus. Walk us through how you would review the file, determine what should be addressed first, and begin the dispute process.”



IMPORTANT

To confirm that you actually read this entire job post, put:

“CFPB READY”

at the very top of your application.



Applications that are missing the phrase, resume, video, screenshots, or written response will not be considered.

title: Accounts Payable Assistant (WFH – Philippines)
description:
We are looking for an experienced Accounts Payable Assistant based in the Philippines to join our Finance team. 

This is a stable, long-term role working with colleagues across multiple countries in a supportive and experienced finance team. 

 

About Us 

MACVAD is an established international sourcing and distribution company with over 60 years of success. We are specialist sourcing and supply agents working across seven countries, supplying major retailers around the world. 

Our success comes from carefully managed growth and strong long-term relationships with both suppliers and customers. Our Finance team works closely with colleagues across different locations and is known for building strong and reliable relationships internally and externally. 

You will be joining a supportive team with solid systems and processes, where accuracy, accountability and teamwork are highly valued. 

 

The Role 

This role focuses on end-to-end Accounts Payable processing, ensuring supplier invoices and payments are processed accurately and supported by the correct documentation. 

Because MACVAD operates internationally, this role also involves working with multiple currencies, different tax jurisdictions, and intercompany transactions. 

 

Key Responsibilities 

* Processing supplier invoices and managing the Accounts Payable workflow 

* Managing invoice authorisation processes and ensuring correct approvals 

* Preparing and processing supplier payments 

* Performing supplier reconciliations 

* Processing company credit card transactions 

* Managing intercompany invoices and reconciliations between different group entities 

* Handling multi-currency supplier invoices and exchange rate differences 

* Reviewing supplier invoices to ensure correct VAT / GST treatment 

* Supporting colleagues with transactional finance queries 

* Maintaining accurate documentation and records 

Trading & Shipping Document Review 

A key part of this role involves reviewing documentation to ensure invoices should be paid. 

This includes checking and matching: 

* Purchase Orders 

* Bills of Lading 

* Packing Lists 

* Commercial Invoices 

The goal is to ensure the accuracy of supplier invoices and confirm that payment terms and shipping documentation align before payments are processed. 

 

About You 

You are someone who enjoys working with numbers and takes pride in producing accurate work. You are organised, efficient and naturally attentive to detail.  You are also tech savvy, can easily learn tools.

You also understand the importance of strong supplier relationships and provide excellent customer service when dealing with queries. 

 

Requirements 

* Minimum 5 years accounting experience 

* Strong end-to-end Accounts Payable experience 

* Experience processing supplier invoices, reconciliations and payments 

* Experience working with multi-currency transactions and exchange rates 

* Experience handling intercompany transactions 

* Understanding of VAT / GST treatment on supplier invoices 

* High attention to detail and accuracy 

* Strong organisational and follow-up skills 

* Excellent written communication 

* Ability to work independently in a remote environment 

* Reliable internet connection 

*Dedicated office workspace

 

Systems Experience 

Experience with Microsoft Dynamics / Business Central would be an advantage. 

However, candidates with experience using other ERP systems such as SAP, NetSuite, Sage, AX or Xero are also encouraged to apply. 

 

Advantageous Experience 

* Experience working in trading, sourcing, logistics or supply businesses 

* Familiarity with shipping documentation 

* German language skills 

 

Personal Qualities 

We are looking for someone who: 

* Has a positive and easy-going working style 

* Enjoys supporting colleagues 

* Has a “can do” attitude 

* Is dependable and takes ownership of their work 

* Is comfortable working in an international team environment 

 

Why Join MACVAD? 

* Established international company with strong client relationships 

* Supportive and experienced finance team 

* Exposure to international business operations 

* Stable long-term role with opportunities to grow 

 

How to Apply 

If this role sounds like a good fit for you, please apply and please include a link to your CV answer the following questions when applying: 

1. How many years of Accounts Payable experience do you have? Please briefly describe the AP tasks you handled. 

2. Have you processed invoices in multiple currencies or handled exchange rate differences? Please explain your experience. 

3. Have you worked with intercompany transactions or reconciliations between different entities? 

4. What accounting or ERP systems have you used in your previous roles? 

5. Do you have experience reviewing shipping or trading documents (e.g., Purchase Orders, Bills of Lading, Packing Lists, Commercial Invoices)? 

6. What is your expected monthly salary (in PHP)? 

7. Please provide a link to your CV or resume.

title: Customer Service, Sales & Booking VA — Excellent Australian Communication Required
description:
I’m looking for a highly capable Virtual Assistant to help manage customer enquiries, sales, bookings, follow-ups and daily administration for a busy Australian service-based business.



This is NOT a basic admin role.



You will communicate directly with customers, qualify enquiries, help convert genuine enquiries into bookings, manage deposits and booking information, follow up potential customers and keep our daily trackers and booking dashboards accurate.



Because you will represent the business directly, excellent communication skills are essential.



AUSTRALIAN COMMUNICATION STYLE IS ESSENTIAL



You must be able to communicate naturally and comfortably with Australian customers.



Australian customers generally prefer communication that is:



- Warm and conversational

- Friendly but professional

- Direct and easy to understand

- Less formal

- Concise

- Human and personalised

- Focused on answering the actual question being asked



I am specifically NOT looking for someone who relies heavily on:



- Scripted or canned responses

- Generic customer service language

- Overly formal communication

- Excessive apologising

- Long explanations when a short answer will do

- AI-generated sounding responses

- Repeating information that hasn't resolved the customer's question

- Acknowledging a customer without actually solving their issue



If a customer asks three questions, I expect all three questions to be answered.



If a customer becomes confused or frustrated, I expect you to recognise it, reread the conversation, identify what hasn't been resolved and adjust your response accordingly.



You need to understand what the customer is actually asking — not simply respond to keywords or follow a script.



YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES



You will manage enquiries from initial contact through to confirmed booking.



This includes determining:



- What day and time the customer wants

- Which service they are interested in

- Whether they want any extras

- Whether they have requested something that isn't offered

- How to appropriately handle requests for unavailable services

- Whether the customer appears genuine, needs more time or is wasting time

- Whether they are ready and willing to pay the required deposit

- Whether the deposit has been paid and received

- Whether the booking has been confirmed

- Whether the correct address and booking information has been sent



You will also be responsible for:



- Responding to ALL enquiries during your working hours

- Responding to new AND ongoing conversations within approximately 10 minutes

- Following up genuine enquiries

- Helping convert enquiries into bookings

- Managing booking communication

- Maintaining professional boundaries

- Updating the Daily Enquiry Tracker

- Updating the Weekly Bookings Dashboard

- Keeping customer and booking information accurate

- Knowing when something should be escalated to me



PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS



I expect:



- 100% of enquiries responded to during working hours

- Responses generally within 10 minutes

- Customer questions answered correctly and completely

- Customers properly qualified before booking

- Booking procedures followed accurately

- Daily Enquiry Tracker completed

- Weekly Bookings Dashboard kept up to date

- Warm, natural and conversational communication

- Minimal avoidable customer complaints

- Accurate customer and booking information



Accuracy and communication quality are more important than simply sending a large number of messages.



WHO I'M LOOKING FOR



You will be a strong fit if you:



- Have excellent written English

- Understand Australian conversational communication

- Communicate naturally rather than sounding scripted

- Have strong customer service and sales skills

- Have appointment-setting or booking experience

- Understand how to qualify leads

- Can recognise buying signals and time-wasters

- Have excellent attention to detail

- Can work independently

- Know when to solve something yourself and when to escalate

- Can handle frustrated customers calmly

- Learn quickly from feedback

- Take responsibility for mistakes

- Do not need constant supervision



Experience working with Australian businesses or Australian customers will be highly regarded.



LONG-TERM OPPORTUNITY



A generous long-term benefits and bonus package is available to high-performing candidates after 6 months of successful continuous engagement.



IMPORTANT



This is a customer-facing position.



You will eventually be trusted with direct access to customer conversations and booking systems, so reliability, judgement, confidentiality and attention to detail are essential.



You will not receive full access immediately.



Successful applicants will first complete an interview and practical assessment so I can evaluate how you communicate, think and handle real customer situations.



STRICT NO-AI POLICY



The use of generative AI is strictly prohibited throughout the application, interview and assessment process for this role.



This includes tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot or similar tools used to write, rewrite, improve, translate, formulate or generate any part of your application or interview responses.



I need to assess YOUR genuine communication skills, judgement, English ability and ability to respond naturally to customers.



Any applicant found to have used generative AI during the recruitment process will be automatically disqualified.



The same policy applies throughout your engagement if you are selected for the role.



Unauthorised use of generative AI in customer communications will be treated as a serious breach of the role requirements and will result in immediate termination of your contractor engagement.



If you rely on accessibility or assistive technology for a disability, please let me know so that an appropriate accommodation can be considered.



HOW TO APPLY



Please do NOT send me a generic cover letter.



I want to see how you actually communicate.



At the beginning of your application, write:



“I understand Australian communication.”



Then answer the following questions in your own words:



1. A customer sends you three different questions in one message. What would you do to make sure you don't a
 answer only one or two of them?



2. A customer has asked the same question twice because your previous response didn't properly answer what they were asking. They now sound frustrated. How would you handle it?



3. What are some signs that a customer is becoming frustrated during a written conversation?



4. What is the difference between acknowledging a customer's concern and actually resolving it?



5. How would you communicate with an Australian customer differently from a very formal corporate customer?



Customer Scenario



A customer messages:



"I've already told you twice that I want Saturday afternoon. I just need to know whether 3pm is available and how much the deposit is. I don't need all the other information again."



Write the EXACT response you would send to this customer.



Keep it short and natural.



Do not tell me what you would say. Write the actual message you would send.



Please answer these questions yourself rather than giving me generic or AI-generated responses.



If your communication style is overly scripted, extremely formal or does not directly answer the questions above, you will not progress to the next stage.

title: EXPERIENCED XACTIMATE RESTORATION ESTIMATOR - $3000 month
description:
# EXPERIENCED XACTIMATE RESTORATION ESTIMATOR



## Full-Time Remote | Phoenix, Arizona Hours



**PLEASE READ THIS ENTIRE JOB POST BEFORE APPLYING.**



There are specific application instructions throughout this post.



**If you do not follow ALL application instructions, you will not be considered for the position.**



We are looking for someone who pays attention to details, follows directions, and takes their career seriously. Consider the application process your first opportunity to show us how you work.



---



# THIS IS NOT AN ENTRY-LEVEL POSITION



**Xactimate experience is REQUIRED.**



You must already be proficient at reviewing restoration documentation and building detailed, accurate Xactimate estimates and invoices.



If you have never written Xactimate estimates yourself, please do not apply.



If you only have basic Xactimate exposure, please do not apply.



If you need someone to teach you how to write restoration estimates from the beginning, this is not the right position.



We are specifically looking for an **experienced estimator who can contribute quickly and continue becoming an expert in the field.**



**Symbility experience is a major bonus.**



---



# ABOUT OUR COMPANY



We are an established restoration company serving Phoenix, Arizona and surrounding cities for the past 15 years!



We handle property damage projects involving:



* Water damage

* Fire and smoke damage

* Mold remediation

* Asbestos abatement

* Reconstruction

* Roofing

* Insurance claims



We have been in business since 2012 and have built our company around doing quality work, taking care of customers, and continually improving how we operate.



We are looking for someone who wants more than a temporary freelance job.



**We want someone who wants to become part of our team, grow with the company, improve their skills, take on more responsibility, and increase their growth and income as their value to the company increases.**



---



# YOUR PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITY



You will work with our restoration team to turn our field documentation into accurate, detailed, defensible estimates and invoices.



Our field team will provide documentation including:



* Photos

* Videos

* Measurements

* Moisture documentation

* Technician notes

* Equipment information

* Scope notes

* Insurance information

* Other supporting documents



You will review that information and build professional estimates and invoices.



You should understand restoration well enough to recognize when documentation supports additional legitimate line items that may have been missed.



We do not want someone who simply enters whatever information is handed to them.



**We want an estimator who understands the work, thinks critically, catches missing items, asks good questions, and produces a complete and defensible scope.**



---



# TYPES OF ESTIMATES YOU MAY WRITE



You should be comfortable working with several types of property damage claims, including:



### Mitigation



* Water mitigation

* Emergency services

* Demolition

* Cleaning

* Contents manipulation

* Mold remediation

* Asbestos abatement



### Reconstruction



* Drywall

* Paint

* Flooring

* Cabinets

* Countertops

* Trim

* Doors

* Framing

* Insulation

* Electrical

* Plumbing

* General reconstruction

* Larger loss reconstruction



### Fire



* Fire damage

* Smoke damage

* Cleaning

* Contents

* Demolition

* Reconstruction

* Large-loss estimating



### Roofing



You may occasionally assist with:



* Roof repairs

* Roof replacements

* Storm damage

* Insurance roofing claims

* Supplements



Roofing experience is preferred but is not required if your restoration estimating experience is strong.



---



# ADJUSTER COMMUNICATION & CLAIM NEGOTIATION



This position is not limited to writing estimates.



You must also be comfortable communicating professionally with insurance adjusters and other claim representatives.



Responsibilities may include:



* Reviewing carrier estimates

* Comparing carrier scopes against our scope

* Identifying missing or incorrect line items

* Preparing supplements

* Providing supporting documentation

* Responding to estimate revisions

* Discussing legitimate scope differences

* Explaining why specific work or line items are necessary

* Following up on outstanding approvals

* Negotiating scope and pricing disagreements

* Moving claims toward resolution and approval



Our goal is not to add unnecessary items to claims.



Our goal is to make sure the estimate accurately reflects the work that was legitimately required or needs to be completed and that our documentation supports our scope.



You must be comfortable professionally defending your estimate.



---



# THE PERSON WE ARE LOOKING FOR



We want someone who:



* Is punctual - If you aren't consistent and cant show up for your shift lets not waste each others time

* Has significant hands-on Xactimate estimating experience

* Can write estimates independently

* Understands restoration terminology and processes

* Understands insurance restoration claims

* Understands mitigation and reconstruction scopes

* Knows how to identify commonly missed legitimate line items

* Understands supporting documentation

* Can review and challenge carrier estimates

* Is comfortable communicating with adjusters

* Writes professional
s

* Communicates clearly with our internal team

* Pays extremely close attention to detail

* Takes ownership of their work

* Meets deadlines

* Does not need constant supervision

* Can manage multiple estimates at the same time

* Asks questions when documentation is incomplete

* Wants to continually improve



We especially want someone who takes pride in becoming **exceptionally good at their craft.**



If you enjoy learning Xactimate, understanding restoration, finding legitimate missing scope items, and building extremely thorough estimates, you're likely an EXCELLENT fit.



---



# REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



You must have:



* Professional Xactimate experience

* Experience personally writing Xactimate estimates

* Strong knowledge of Xactimate line items

* Restoration and/or insurance estimating experience

* Strong written English & spoken English

* Strong attention to detail

* Ability to work independently

* Reliable computer

* Reliable high-speed internet



Preferred experience:



* Symbility

* Water mitigation

* Mold remediation

* Asbestos

* Fire restoration

* Reconstruction

* Roofing

* Supplements

* Adjuster negotiations

* Large-loss estimating

* Insurance restoration contractors



---



# HOURS



This is a **full-time remote position.**



You will work primarily during **Phoenix, Arizona business hours.**



You must be available and responsive during your scheduled working hours because you will be working directly with our Arizona team and communicating with insurance representatives.



---



# COMPENSATION



**Starting compensation: $6.00-$14.00 USD per hour, depending heavily on experience and demonstrated ability.**



This is not intended to be a dead-end position.



There will be opportunities for:



* Pay increases

* Performance bonuses

* Increased responsibility

* Professional development

* Leadership opportunities

* Long-term career advancement



We reward people who create value, take ownership, continually improve, and make the team better.



---



# HOW TO APPLY



**Read this section carefully.**



Your application must include ALL of the following.



## 1.
/APPLICATION SUBJECT



The title or subject of your application must contain:



**ESTIMATOR HIRING MANAGER**



If "ESTIMATOR HIRING MANAGER" is not included at the beginning of your reply, your application will not be considered.



---



## 2. ANSWER THESE QUESTIONS



Copy these questions into your application and answer each one.



1. How many years have you personally used Xactimate?



2. On a scale of 1-10, how would you rate your Xactimate ability?



3. What types of estimates have you written? List all that apply:



   * Water mitigation

   * Mold

   * Asbestos

   * Fire

   * Reconstruction

   * Roofing

   * Contents

   * Large loss

   * Other



4. Have you written mitigation invoices from technician photos, notes, drying logs, and equipment documentation?



5. Have you written reconstruction estimates from photos, measurements, Matterport, sketches, or field documentation?



6. How many years of Symbility experience do you have?



7. Have you personally communicated or negotiated scope with insurance adjusters?



8. Describe your experience handling supplements and disagreements with carrier estimates.



9. What are some Xactimate line items or charges you commonly see missed on water mitigation estimates?



10. What are some commonly missed items you look for when reviewing reconstruction estimates?



11. What is the largest estimate you have personally written?



12. Approximately how many estimates can you accurately complete during a normal week?



13. Which estimating or restoration certifications do you currently have, if any?



14. What restoration companies, estimating companies, adjusting firms, or insurance-related companies have you previously worked with?



15. Are you currently working for another company? If yes, explain your current schedule.



16. Are you able to work full-time during Phoenix, Arizona business hours?



17. Why are you looking for a new position?



---



# 3. SUBMIT ESTIMATE SAMPLES



Please submit **2-3 estimates or claims that YOU personally wrote.**



We would prefer to see different types of losses if possible.



Examples:



* Water mitigation invoice

* Reconstruction estimate

* Fire estimate

* Roofing estimate



**If you will feel more comfortable, please remove or redact customer names, addresses, claim numbers, phone numbers, and any other confidential information before submitting them.**



We want to evaluate:



* Estimate organization

* Level of detail

* Line-item selection

* F9 notes

* Scope completeness

* Supporting explanations

* Estimating strategy

* Overall professionalism



Do not submit someone else's work. We will know as soon as we get you to the interview stage



Be prepared to explain the estimates you submit during your interview.



---



# 4. RECORD A 3-5 MINUTE LOOM VIDEO



Send us a Loom video introducing yourself.



Your video should explain:



* Who you are

* Your restoration estimating background

* Your Xactimate experience

* Your Symbility experience, if applicable

* Types of claims you have worked on

* Your experience dealing with adjusters

* Your experience writing supplements

* What you believe separates an average estimator from an excellent estimator

* Why you believe you would be a strong fit 

* What you want your career to look like over the next 2-3 years



**Please keep the video between 3 and 5 minutes.**



We are not judging video production quality.



We want to understand how you communicate, how well you understand estimating, and whether you would be a good fit working directly with our team.



---



# IMPORTANT



We expect a lot from the person we hire, but we also want to create a position that the right person will want to stay in for years.



We are looking for someone who wants:



* Stability

* Growth

* More responsibility

* Increased income

* A strong team

* A company that is continually improving

* The opportunity to become an expert in their field



If you are an experienced restoration estimator who knows Xactimate extremely well and wants an opportunity to grow with an established restoration company, we want to hear from you.



**Remember:**



* Read the entire posting.

* Put **ESTIMATOR** **HIRING MANAGER** in your application title.

* Answer all 20 questions.

* Submit 2-3 examples of estimates YOU personally created.

* Submit your 3-5 minute Loom video.

* Follow every instruction.



**Incomplete applications will not be considered.**
