title: Unreal Engine Game Developer
description:
Who We Are:

At Happy Little Games, games are art. We are an independent studio built by gamers, for gamers, making the kinds of games we would want to play ourselves. We care about creating games that are fun, memorable, and worth the time players spend with them. Every project is a chance to build something distinct that we are genuinely proud of.



Why Work Here:

If you love games and enjoy building things, this is a place where you can do both in a flexible, supportive environment. We are fully remote, you can set your own schedule, and we do not believe in crunch. We care about the quality of your work and whether you get things done, not how many hours you sit at a desk.



You also get to work closely with a small team and decide how you want to grow. You can deepen your expertise in the work you already enjoy, explore other areas of game development, or grow into a different role over time. Being good at one thing does not mean you have to do only that thing forever.



Role Overview

* Build and prototype gameplay features in Unreal Engine using Blueprints.

* Work on gameplay systems, basic AI, physics, interactions, and related gameplay functionality.

* Create focused test environments that clearly show how a feature works.

* Test and debug your own work before submitting it for review.

* Keep implementation focused on the requested scope and avoid unnecessary files, systems, or dependencies.

* Document what you build, how it works, and how it should be tested.

* Manage assigned user stories, communicate progress, and raise questions, blockers, or risks early.

* Learn and follow the studio’s technical standards, workflows, and development practices.





What You Need to Bring:

You do not need to know every Unreal Engine system before joining us, but you should already be able to work productively without constant step-by-step instruction. You should already be able to:



* Work comfortably within Unreal Engine.

* Build functional gameplay features using Blueprints.

* Build simple gameplay systems and basic AI behavior.

* Apply basic software-development principles, including logic, data flow, organization, and debugging.

* Test and debug your own work before submitting it for review.

* Test both the expected behavior and a basic control case where the feature should not activate or behave the same way.

* Research unfamiliar but well-documented problems and make reasonable progress independently.

* Manage your own time and keep assigned work moving toward completion.

* Keep your work focused on the requested scope.

* Ask useful questions when requirements or technical direction are unclear.

* Communicate progress, blockers, and risks early.

* Create and maintain basic documentation for your work.

* Keep project files and implementation reasonably clean and organized.

* Explain how your work functions and why you made important implementation decisions.

* Remain professional, dependable, and honest about what you do and do not know.



What You Can Learn Here:

You are not required to already know every tool, framework, or production practice used by the studio. You can learn or further develop the following after joining:



* Git and the studio’s source-control workflow.

* Notion and the studio’s user-story workflow.

* Agile and Scrum practices.

* The Gameplay Ability System and how it is used within our projects.

* The studio’s architecture, naming conventions, and technical standards.

* Formal system-design and diagramming practices.

* Stronger documentation practices.

* Multiplayer replication.

* Basic C++ as your responsibilities grow.

* More advanced gameplay, AI, animation, physics, and Unreal Engine systems.



You should be willing to research these areas, learn from available documentation and examples, and apply feedback to future work.



Compensation:

Your final hourly rate will be based on your experience, demonstrated skills, technical ability, communication, and level of independence. We will determine the appropriate rate through the interview and trial process.



Work Progression:

New developers begin with a trial project so we can evaluate how they work, communicate, and deliver against a real set of requirements. Developers who complete the trial successfully may continue with project-based work. From there, strong and consistent contributors may move into hourly work as availability and studio needs allow.

As the company grows, hourly developers may also have the opportunity to move into a full-time role if both sides are interested.



How to Apply:

Please apply through OnlineJobs.ph whenever possible and include your resume, portfolio, and any relevant Unreal Engine work samples. If you are unable to contact us through OnlineJobs.ph for any reason, you may also reach us via
. Please include the position you are applying for in the subject line.

title: Technical Generalist - Web Ops & CMS Maintenance (Python/JS, AI-assisted)
description:
A US sports talent agency running two connected web properties: a main booking site on Strapi, and a growing portfolio of individual websites for the athletes we represent, running on a custom platform we built ourselves (Python/FastAPI backend, React admin, HTML template layer).



Right now every problem across both — a wrong career stat, a booking form that stopped submitting, a template that renders badly on mobile, a CMS field behaving strangely — routes to one person. We are hiring the person it routes to instead.



THE WORK, ROUGHLY IN ORDER OF VOLUME



1. Content operations. Adding athletes to the CMS from source material we provide: bio, career credits, photos, video embeds, category tagging, fee and availability fields. Publishing short news items to a spec. Keeping existing profiles current. This is the steady baseline and it needs no code.



2. Troubleshooting. "The booking link on this page goes nowhere." "This section renders wrong." "The CMS will not save this field." You diagnose it, decide whether it is content, configuration or code, and fix it or escalate with a clear description of what you found.



3. Code fixes, by pull request. Small, scoped fixes against either codebase. You work on a branch, you write the PR, you explain the change, you test it before pushing. You will not have merge rights — every PR is reviewed and merged by us.



4. Template changes. Changes to the shared templates that affect every athlete site at once. These are the highest-blast-radius work we have, and they are the reason this role is technical rather than administrative. Developed against a local stack, verified on a private canary site, and approved before they reach real athletes.



HOW YOU ARE EXPECTED TO WORK



AI-first. We run this operation with AI assistance throughout and we expect you to do the same — Claude, Cursor, Copilot, whatever you are fluent in. This is not a tolerance, it is a requirement, and your throughput will be measured against what the same work takes us with AI assistance.



The corollary matters more than the tool: you are accountable for what you ship, including the parts an AI wrote. We want someone who can tell when a generated fix is right, when it is plausible and wrong, and when it works for a reason they cannot yet explain — and who slows down at exactly that third case. These are public pages about real, named, recognizable people. A confidently wrong career stat on someone's own website is worse than a slow turnaround.



THE TRUST LADDER



Everything starts gated. Early on, template and code changes come to us for approval before they go anywhere. As you demonstrate judgment, categories of work get released to you: first "do this without asking", then "you decide whether this needs asking." We are not looking for someone to stay at step one.



HOW WE HIRE — YOU GET PAID FOR THE TEST



We do not run unpaid test tasks. We have a genuine backlog and the trial is real work from it. You are paid your normal rate for every stage and we keep and use the output whether or not you advance. Stages will cover a variety of tasks.



We run this with three to four candidates in parallel and compare directly. Being paid throughout is what makes that fair.



AFTER THE TRIAL



A fixed monthly block of hours, ongoing — predictable for you, predictable for us, and it means you build real familiarity with the systems rather than context-switching in cold each time. Scope and autonomy grow on merit.



WHAT WE NEED YOU TO HAVE



- Comfortable reading and modifying both Python and JavaScript. You do not need to be strong in both; you need to be unafraid of either.

- Git and pull requests as normal daily practice, not something you looked up once.

- Genuine fluency with an AI coding assistant, including its failure modes.

- Enough HTML/CSS to change a template and know what you broke.

- Care about factual accuracy in writing about real people.

- Working hours with at least a few hours of overlap with US business hours.



Strapi, FastAPI or React experience specifically is a bonus, not a requirement.



TO APPLY



Please answer all six of these in your application. We read the answers, and applications that skip them will not be reviewed.



1. Begin your reply with the name of one sport you follow closely enough to spot an error in a player's career summary.

2. Describe a change you shipped recently where you used an AI coding assistant, and be specific about the moment you had to override or correct what it produced. What made you distrust it?

3. You receive a ticket that says, in full: "The booking link on his page is broken." No other detail. What are your first three steps, in order?

4. You need to change a shared template that renders 20 live websites. Walk us through how you would get that change to production without breaking any of them.

5. From source material we provide, how many athlete profiles — bio, career credits, one photo, correct category — could you complete to a publishable standard in one hour? What would slow that number down?

6. Your hourly rate, your time zone, and whether you can commit to a recurring monthly block of hours.

title: Appointment Setter / Cold Caller
description:
Cold Caller / Outbound Appointment Setter



Location: Fully Remote (Ph) Schedule: Monday–Friday, 10:00 AM–6:00 PM EST (approximately 11:00 PM–7:00 AM Manila time — this is a night shift) Compensation: $1,000 USD per month base + $25 USD per qualified appointment that shows + $100 USD per client that signs



About T3 Tech Partners



T3 Tech Partners is the team MSPs rely on when challenges exceed Tier 2 or internal expertise. We operate as a Fractional Tier 3 partner, delivering advanced Systems Administration, Infrastructure, Networking cloud, and security expertise to MSPs supporting diverse client environments.



Our engineers are trusted technical partners — leading implementations, resolving complex escalations, and working directly with MSP clients to execute real-world solutions. Our outbound team is the first voice those partners hear, and that first impression matters.



Role Overview



We are seeking an experienced Cold Caller / Outbound Appointment Setter to drive outbound prospecting into Managed Service Providers and IT firms across the United States. You will own the top of the funnel — building call lists, making high-volume outbound calls, handling objections in real time, and booking qualified discovery meetings for our leadership team.



This is a voice-first, customer-facing role. Native-level spoken English is a hard requirement, not a preference. You will be speaking with US-based business owners, IT directors, and MSP principals every day. Applicants with a noticeable accent that impedes clarity, or with hesitant, scripted-sounding delivery, will not be advanced.



This role requires resilience, independence, and the ability to hold a confident business conversation with senior technical decision-makers without a script to hide behind.



Key Responsibilities

Outbound Calling & Prospecting

Make a high volume of outbound cold calls per day to MSPs, IT service firms, and internal IT departments across US time zones.

Open conversations confidently with owners, principals, and IT decision-makers.

Qualify prospects against our ideal-client profile (company size, service mix, existing Tier 3 gaps).

Handle gatekeepers professionally and consistently reach the decision-maker.

Book qualified discovery calls and appointments directly onto the sales calendar.

Objection Handling & Conversation Quality

Respond to objections in real time without reading verbatim from a script.

Adapt tone and pacing to the person on the other end of the line.

Communicate our value proposition clearly to a technical audience without overstating technical claims.

Know when to disqualify a prospect quickly and move on.

Follow-Up & Pipeline Management

Execute structured follow-up sequences by phone,
, and LinkedIn.

Log every call, outcome, and next step accurately in the CRM the same day.

Maintain and clean prospect lists, correcting bad data as you encounter it.

Nurture "not right now" prospects on a defined callback cadence.

Reporting & Continuous Improvement

Report daily and weekly on dials, connects, conversations, and appointments set.

Participate in call reviews and act on coaching feedback.

Test and report on messaging, opening lines, and list segments.

Flag recurring objections and market feedback to leadership.

Availability & Support Expectations

Standard working hours are 10:00 AM–6:00 PM EST, Monday through Friday.

This is a night shift in the Philippines — roughly 11:00 PM to 7:00 AM Manila time. Please only apply if you have worked a graveyard schedule before and can sustain it long term.

Some flexibility is required during active campaigns or event-driven outreach.

This role is not on-call, but consistent attendance during US business hours is essential.

Qualifications

Required Experience

2+ years of outbound cold calling, appointment setting, or SDR experience into the US market.

Native-level or near-native English, spoken and written, with a neutral or American accent. Clear articulation, natural pacing, and confident phone presence are non-negotiable.

Proven ability to hold unscripted business conversations with senior decision-makers.

Demonstrated track record of hitting dial, conversation, and appointment-set targets.

Experience with CRM and dialer platforms (HubSpot, Go High Level, Close, Aircall, or similar).

Reliable high-speed internet, a quiet dedicated workspace, a backup power source, and a quality noise-cancelling headset.

Comfortable with rejection and high call volume; self-directed with minimal supervision.

Preferred Experience

Prior outbound experience selling into MSPs, IT services, or B2B technology.

Working familiarity with Microsoft 365, cloud, or managed IT terminology.

Experience building or sourcing prospect lists (Apollo, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator).

Compensation

Base: $1,000 USD per month, paid twice monthly.

Appointment commission: $25 USD for every qualified appointment that shows.

Conversion bonus: $100 USD for every prospect who signs on for services after a meeting you booked.

No minimum threshold. Commission is paid from the first qualified appointment.



What counts as a qualified appointment:



The meeting must actually take place, and the person on the call must be a decision-maker or a decision-influencer — an owner, principal, partner, CEO, CTO, IT director, IT manager, service manager, or operations manager. A help desk technician, receptionist, or office administrator does not count, even if they agreed to the meeting.



Commission is paid on the meeting that actually happens. Reschedules do not affect the commission — if the meeting eventually takes place with a qualifying contact, it is paid. Appointments that are never held are not paid.



Conversion bonus:



If a prospect you booked signs a services agreement with T3 Tech Partners, you receive an additional $100 USD. The bonus is paid on signature, and it applies for 90 days from the date of your booked meeting, so you are still credited when a deal takes time to close.



What this adds up to:



At a normal pace of 15 to 20 held appointments per month, base plus appointment commission lands between $1,375 and $1,500. Two signed clients in a month brings that to roughly $1,600 to $1,700. There is no cap on the conversion bonus.



HOW TO APPLY — AUDIO SAMPLE REQUIRED



Applications without an audio sample will not be reviewed. This is the first thing we check.



Because this role is judged on how you sound on the phone, every applicant must submit a voice recording of 60 to 90 seconds. Record it yourself, in your own voice, in one take.



In your recording, please cover:



Your name and where you are based.

A brief summary of your outbound calling experience and the markets you have called into.

A live mock cold call opener: imagine you have just reached the owner of a US-based MSP who did not expect your call. Deliver your opening 20 to 30 seconds exactly as you would on a real dial.

How you would respond if that owner said, "We already have an internal engineer for that."



How to send it:



Record using any free app or tool you like, then paste the shareable link directly into the job post chat here on OnlineJobs.ph. Free options that work well:



Vocaroo (
) — record in your browser, no account needed, gives you an instant link.

Voice Spice (
) — browser-based recorder with a shareable link.

Clyp (
) — free hosting with a direct link.

Google Drive or Dropbox — record on your phone, upload, and share the link.



Make sure your link is set so that anyone with the link can listen. We cannot chase down permission requests, and locked links will be treated as no submission.



Along with your audio link, please include in the chat:



Your resume or a link to it.

The number of outbound dials you typically made per day in your last role.

Confirmation that you can work 10:00 AM–6:00 PM EST (11:00 PM–7:00 AM Manila time), and whether you have held a night shift role before.



We review every submission that includes an audio sample. Strong candidates will be invited to a short live phone screen — where, again, how you sound will matter most.

title: Level 3 IT Technician
description:
Location: Fully Remote (Ph)

Schedule: As Needed, will message via whatsapp when advanced tickets requiring these skills come through. US based company, working US east coast hours.



About T3 Tech Partners



T3 Tech Partners is the team MSPs rely on when challenges exceed Tier 2 or internal expertise. We operate as a Fractional Tier 3 partner, delivering advanced Microsoft 365, cloud, and security expertise to MSPs supporting diverse client environments.

Our engineers are trusted technical partners — leading implementations, resolving complex escalations, and working directly with MSP clients to execute real-world solutions.

________________________________________

This is a technical, customer-facing role — while not sales-focused, you will regularly work directly with customers to design and implement the solutions required to meet their business and technical needs.

This role requires strong technical depth, independence, and the ability to step into unfamiliar environments and software ecosystems with confidence.

________________________________________

Key Responsibilities

Advanced Cloud & Escalation Support

Microsoft 365 (Core Focus Area)

, identity, security, document management, line-of-business platforms).

Projects, Optimization & Automation

Availability & Support Expectations

• Standard working hours are 9:00 AM–5:00 PM EST.

• Some flexibility is required for high-impact client issues, critical changes, or migrations outside normal hours.

• This role is not on-call, but responsiveness during critical events is expected.

title: Outbound Telemarketing Manager | US Hours | $1,200-$2,000 Monthly
description:
We are a growing US-based marketing agency seeking an experienced Outbound Telemarketing Manager to lead a remote team of callers in the Philippines.



Our callers contact US businesses to identify decision-makers who are genuinely open to receiving a commercial cleaning quote or walkthrough.



You will initially manage approximately 15 to 30 callers, with the opportunity to help build the systems needed to scale the department further.



This is not an administrative-only position. You will actively monitor the calling floor, listen to calls, coach agents, enforce attendance standards, analyze performance, and take ownership of production and lead quality.



RESPONSIBILITIES



-Manage approximately 15 to 30 remote outbound callers

-Run a brief daily kickoff meeting before calling begins

-Monitor attendance, punctuality, dialer activity, availability, and agent adherence

-Track dials, connections, conversations, QA-approved opportunities, disqualification rates, and caller productivity

-Listen to live and recorded calls throughout the day

-Identify weak openings, poor objection handling, unclear communication, and false-interest leads

-Provide direct daily coaching to underperforming callers

-Conduct weekly one-on-one performance reviews

-Help train and evaluate new callers during their trial period

-Recommend when callers should receive additional coaching or be released

-Investigate dialer, data, script, and performance problems before they affect the entire team

-Maintain accurate daily and weekly management reports

-Work closely with ownership and QA to increase production without lowering lead quality



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



-More QA-approved opportunities produced per caller-day

-Consistent lead quality and genuine prospect interest

-Strong attendance and minimal unexplained inactivity

-Fast identification of struggling callers

-Clear coaching with measurable follow-through

-Accurate reporting with no surprises

-A disciplined, motivated, and accountable calling floor



REQUIREMENTS



-At least 3 years of outbound telemarketing, call-center, or sales management experience

-Direct experience managing at least 10 outbound callers

-Strong understanding of cold-calling metrics and conversion funnels

-Demonstrated ability to improve agent performance through call review and coaching

-Excellent spoken and written English

-Comfortable delivering direct feedback and enforcing performance standards

-Strong analytical and problem-solving ability

-Reliable computer, internet connection, headset, and quiet workspace

-Available full-time during US Eastern Time business hours

-No conflicting full-time employment



Experience with B2B appointment setting, lead generation, predictive or power dialers, and Philippine remote teams is strongly preferred.



COMPENSATION



$1,200 to $1,500 USD monthly base, depending on experience

Up to $500 USD in additional monthly performance bonuses

Long-term, full-time opportunity

Opportunity to grow into a senior operations role as the department expands



The performance bonus will be based on measurable results, including caller production, QA approval rates, attendance, coaching completion, and reporting accuracy.



SCHEDULE



Monday through Friday

Approximately 9:30 AM to 5:30 PM US Eastern Time



HOW TO APPLY



Use the subject line:



Outbound Manager - [Your Name]



Please include:



Your resume

The largest outbound team you have directly managed

The type of campaigns you managed

Your expected monthly base compensation

A link to a 3 to 5-minute Loom video answering the questions below



VIDEO QUESTIONS



1. Describe an outbound team you managed, including the number of callers, the campaign, and the primary performance metric.

2. Give one specific example of a performance problem you fixed. Include the metric before your intervention, what you changed, and the result afterward.

3. Imagine 20 callers are producing fewer qualified opportunities, but their conversation volume has not changed. What are the first three things you would investigate?

4. Explain what your daily management routine would look like while the callers are actively dialing.



Please do not submit a highly edited introduction video. We want to see how clearly and confidently you communicate in a normal working environment.



Applications without the requested video and specific examples may not be considered.

title: Level 3 Network Architect
description:
Network Engineer (Level 3) — On-Call / As-Needed



Location: Fully Remote (Ph) Schedule: As needed. You will be contacted via WhatsApp when advanced tickets requiring these skills come through. Hours: Availability during US East Coast business hours (EST) when engaged Engagement Type: Ongoing as-needed contractor — this is not a full-time salaried position Compensation: [RATE TO BE INSERTED]



About T3 Tech Partners



T3 Tech Partners is a US-based company and the team MSPs rely on when challenges exceed Tier 2 or internal expertise. We operate as a Fractional Tier 3 partner, delivering advanced Systems Administration, infrastructure, cloud, network, and security expertise to MSPs supporting diverse client environments.



Our engineers are trusted technical partners — leading implementations, resolving complex escalations, and working directly with MSP clients to execute real-world solutions.



Role Overview



We are seeking a senior-level Network Engineer to serve as an on-call escalation resource for complex networking issues across our MSP partners' client environments.



This is an as-needed engagement, not a scheduled full-time role. When an advanced network ticket comes through that requires this skill set, we will reach out to you directly via WhatsApp. You are expected to acknowledge quickly and, when you accept the work, engage during US East Coast business hours until the issue is resolved or handed back.



This structure suits someone who already has a primary role or an independent consulting practice and wants additional senior-level work on a flexible basis. It does not suit someone who needs guaranteed weekly hours or predictable income.



This role requires strong technical depth, independence, and the ability to step into an unfamiliar network with limited documentation and orient yourself quickly.



Key Responsibilities

Advanced Network Escalation Support

Take ownership of advanced and expert-level network escalations passed up from MSP Tier 1 and Tier 2 teams.

Diagnose complex connectivity, performance, latency, and packet loss issues across LAN, WAN, and hybrid environments.

Perform root-cause analysis and implement durable fixes rather than temporary workarounds.

Work directly with MSP technicians and, where required, end customers to execute resolutions.

Document findings, changes made, and recommendations at the close of every engagement.

Firewalls & Network Security

Configure, troubleshoot, and optimize enterprise firewalls including Fortinet FortiGate, SonicWall, Cisco, Meraki, Palo Alto, and similar platforms.

Design and troubleshoot site-to-site IPsec VPNs, SSL VPNs, and remote access solutions.

Implement network segmentation, VLAN isolation, and access control policies.

Configure and tune IDS/IPS, content filtering, geo-blocking, and threat protection features.

Review and remediate firewall rule bases for security and performance.

Routing, Switching & Wireless

Configure and troubleshoot managed switching including VLANs, trunking, spanning tree, link aggregation, QoS, and PoE.

Work with static routing, policy-based routing, and dynamic routing protocols (OSPF, BGP) as environments require.

Deploy, tune, and troubleshoot enterprise wireless environments (Meraki, Ubiquiti, Ruckus, Aruba, Cisco).

Perform wireless coverage, roaming, interference, and density troubleshooting.

Diagnose DNS, DHCP, NAT, and IP addressing issues.

WAN, Circuits & Cloud Connectivity

Troubleshoot ISP circuits, hand-offs, and carrier issues, and manage escalations with providers.

Configure and support SD-WAN deployments, failover, and multi-WAN load balancing.

Build and troubleshoot hybrid connectivity into Azure, including virtual networks, VPN gateways, and site-to-site tunnels.

Support network requirements for Microsoft 365 workloads, including QoS for Teams voice and video.

Assist with network cutovers, ISP migrations, and office relocations.

Analysis & Documentation

Perform packet captures and protocol analysis (Wireshark or equivalent) to isolate difficult issues.

Produce or update network diagrams, IP schemes, and configuration documentation as part of engagement close-out.

Provide clear written summaries that an MSP Tier 2 technician can act on and learn from.

Recommend standards and long-term improvements to MSP partners where appropriate.

Availability & Engagement Expectations

You will be contacted via WhatsApp when a qualifying ticket comes in. Acknowledgement is expected within a reasonable window during US East Coast business hours.

You are free to decline any individual engagement, but consistent unavailability will end the arrangement.

When you accept an engagement, you are expected to work it through to resolution or to a clean hand-off.

Some work may fall outside standard hours for maintenance windows, cutovers, or critical outages. These are scheduled in advance where possible.

Volume varies. Some weeks will bring multiple escalations, others none.

Qualifications

Required Experience

5+ years of hands-on network engineering experience, with significant time in an MSP or multi-client environment.

Expert-level proficiency with enterprise firewall platforms (Fortinet, SonicWall, Cisco, Meraki, Palo Alto, or comparable).

Strong command of routing and switching fundamentals, VLANs, VPN technologies, and network troubleshooting methodology.

Demonstrated ability to resolve issues that Tier 2 teams could not.

Experience with packet capture and protocol-level analysis.

Comfort working in unfamiliar environments with incomplete documentation.

Excellent native-level English communication, written and verbal. You will be speaking directly with US-based MSP technicians and client stakeholders, often under pressure during an outage.

Reliable high-speed internet, a backup power source, and a quiet workspace suitable for client calls.

Proven experience working in MSP environments (required).

Preferred Experience

Relevant certifications (Fortinet NSE, Cisco CCNP, Meraki CMNA, Palo Alto PCNSE, or similar).

Azure networking and hybrid cloud connectivity experience.

SD-WAN design and deployment experience.

VoIP and unified communications network troubleshooting.

Familiarity with Microsoft 365 network requirements and optimization.

Scripting or automation experience for network configuration and auditing.

HOW TO APPLY



Please reply in the job post chat here on OnlineJobs.ph with the following:



Your resume or a link to it.

A specific example of a network escalation you resolved that another team could not. Describe the symptoms, how you isolated the cause, and what you did to fix it. Two or three paragraphs is enough. This is the part we read most closely.

The firewall platforms you have the deepest experience with, and roughly how many deployments you have worked on for each.

Your hourly rate in USD.

Confirmation that you can be reached via WhatsApp and can engage during US East Coast business hours.

Any relevant certifications, with dates.



Candidates who move forward will complete a live technical conversation over video. Please be prepared to talk through your troubleshooting approach without notes.

title: Full-Time WFH Client Success Manager — $2,000 Base + Bonuses
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



Full-Time | Monday-Friday | PH Morning / US Evening Coverage



We are hiring Philippines-based Client Success Managers to support U.S. clients during evening hours, especially Pacific Time.



This is a client leadership role, not just support.



You will own the client relationship, keep clients clear and accountable, create momentum, prevent frustration, and escalate risks early.



This role is best for someone with excellent English, strong emotional intelligence, high ownership, and confidence handling high-ticket clients calmly.



Success is measured by retention, trust, communication, accountability, client momentum, and risk prevention.



SALARY



- Ramp / Trial CSM: USD 1,500/month base

- Certified CSM: USD 2,000/month base

- OTE: USD 2,500-3,000+/month with performance bonuses

- Paid twice a month via Wise

- Certification is performance-based, usually reviewed after 30-60 days, and requires consistent performance, quality-control review, and leadership approval



SCHEDULE



- Monday-Friday

- Full-time: 7.5 hours a day; 37.5 hours/week

- Core client coverage: 6 AM-12 PM PH time

- Split shifts are allowed

- Afternoons and early evenings are generally free

- Required team/training meetings may happen around 9 PM-11 PM PH time

- Occasional client calls may run up to 12 PM PH time when needed

- Final schedule will be agreed during hiring and must be sustainable long-term



ABOUT US



We help creators, beginners, coaches, and business owners grow and monetize online using short-form content, AI tools, strategy, coaching, and accountability.



We provide an “80% done-for-you” content and monetization system that helps clients turn short-form content into audience growth, leads, and income.



We have worked with 4,000+ clients since 2019.



Most clients are U.S.-based, and many are age 45+, so patience, clarity, emotional intelligence, and professional English communication are very important.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run client kickoff calls using our onboarding framework

- Set clear expectations from day one

- Help clients understand what to do next and why it matters

- Keep clients accountable to action items and deadlines

- Follow up with stuck, quiet, inactive, or delayed clients

BENEFITS



- Fully remote role

- Payment: Twice a month via Wise, always on time

- Performance-based bonuses

- Clear path from Ramp / Trial CSM to Certified CSM

- Growth opportunity into leadership

- Supportive international team

- Daily trainings and team Zoom calls

- SOPs, support, and structure provided

- Work with creators, brands, short-form content, and AI tools

- Required tools paid for after the test month where applicable

- Afternoons and early evenings generally free, with required evening meetings



REQUIREMENTS



- Currently based in the Philippines

- Fluent, professional English

- Clear and easily understood verbal communication

- Strong communication and emotional intelligence

- Calm under pressure

- High ownership, follow-through, and reliability

- Strong say-do ratio and respect for deadlines

- Comfortable handling difficult, emotional, or high-ticket clients

- Comfortable with uncomfortable conversations

- Willing to use Hubstaff during working hours

- Able to identify and escalate refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and client-satisfaction risks quickly



NICE TO HAVE EXPERIENCE



- Client Success

- High-ticket programs

- Social media monetization

- Creator economy

WE’RE THE RIGHT FIT IF



You’ll likely thrive here if you:



- Enjoy client-facing communication

- Stay calm when clients are emotional, frustrated, or confused

- Want a long-term role with growth potential

Apply here:

title: Full-Time WFH Technical Onboarding Specialist — $900 Base + Bonuses
description:
We are hiring a Technical Onboarding Manager (TOM).



Your job is to guide new clients through their first 48 hours inside the program. You remove confusion, fix tech issues, assign the right 1:1 Coach, and make sure clients are fully set up before strategy begins.



This is not a passive support role. You are responsible for structure, clarity, activation speed, and client confidence.



This is a client-facing role. You must be clear, confident, calm, and reliable.



Most of our clients are 45+ and not tech-savvy. Patience and strong communication are required.



BENEFITS



- Salary: $900 per month

- Payment: Twice a month via Wise. Always on time.

- Performance bonuses based on CSAT (client rating) and CSQ (coach rating)

- OTE: $1,050–$1,400/month

- Bonus tiers from $30–$100 per category (minimum 20 surveys / 20 handoffs per month)

- Fully remote, long-term role

- Clear scorecard and monthly reviews

- Career growth path (Senior TOM, Lead TOM, CSM)

- 4,000+ clients served since 2019



SCHEDULE



- Full-time: 7.5 hours a day; 37.5 hours/week

- No fixed shift required. You may work a straight or split shift.

- You must attend team meetings (usually 3pm CET)

- Work 7.5 total hours per day within the 8 AM ET to 2 AM ET coverage window, not across the entire window

- Confirm your preferred working hours during hiring

- Maintain a schedule that is sustainable long term



Consistently low energy or repeated mistakes caused by poor schedule management will be treated as performance issues.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run structured Activation Calls

- Fully activate every client within 48 hours. Activation means the client has access to Kajabi, Slack, the Client Master Sheet, AI tools (AVA & VERA), understands where everything is, has a Coach assigned, and has their Kickoff Call booked.

- Book Kickoff Call same day or next day

- Assign the correct 1:1 Coach based on phase, fluency, timezone, and availability

- Build authority for the assigned Coach so the client feels confident before strategy begins

- Ensure basic access or setup issues do not reach Coaches

- Update CRM immediately after each call

- Send clear handoff notes to Coaches

- Upload all call recordings

- Reply in #tech-support within 24 hours (weekdays)

- Onboard 20–25 clients per week. Activation Calls are structured and typically 30–45 minutes.

Some weeks are high-volume during promotions. Quality and clarity must remain strong under pressure.

- Keep your calendar accurate and available

- Proactively manage your calendar capacity and flag issues early

- Avoid repeated client-facing process errors



Main goal: Zero confusion for the client. No surprises for the Coach.



CORE STANDARDS



- 100% activation within 48 hours

- CSAT average 85%+

- No Kickoff Call no-shows

- Prevent basic technical escalations

- High CRM accuracy and immediate handoffs

- 24-hour Slack response time

- Reliable, consistent performance



REQUIREMENTS



- Strong customer support or onboarding experience

- C1 English or higher

- Calm with older or low-tech clients

- Comfortable repeating instructions clearly multiple times

- Follows SOPs and scripts closely

- Advanced Slack skills

- Comfortable with Kajabi, Google Drive, and Zoom

- Willing to learn basic creator tools

- Reliable internet, strong camera, proper lighting, and quiet workspace

- Strong schedule discipline



WE ARE NOT A FIT IF



- You are low energy or unclear

- You get frustrated with confused clients

- You cannot explain tech in simple words

- You struggle to follow structured processes

- You cannot consistently maintain agreed working hours

- You have poor camera, lighting, or internet setup



HOW TO APPLY



Fill in the form: 
/to/nI8lIXV4



In the Name field, write: “TOM” + Your First and Last Name



Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.



P.S. Once hired, you will be contracted under Social Influence Consulting LLC.

title: OUTBOUND TELEMARKETER / APPOINTMENT SETTER – NEW ZEALAND INSURANCE FIRM
description:
Are you confident on the phone, competitive, and experienced at turning cold leads into appointments?



JD Life is a successful and growing New Zealand financial advice firm. As our business continues to expand, we are looking for an experienced Outbound Telemarketer / Appointment Setter based in the Philippines to join our team.



This is not a customer service or inbound calling position. We are looking for someone who enjoys outbound sales, knows how to handle objections, and is motivated by achieving targets.



We monitor call activity, results and appointments, so we are particularly interested in candidates who have previously been a top performer, top seller or top appointment setter.



What You'll Be Doing



Your main responsibility will be speaking with prospective New Zealand clients and generating quality appointments for our advisers.



Your duties will include:



Making outbound calls to cold leads

Introducing JD Life's services to prospective clients

Building rapport quickly and confidently over the phone

Handling objections and converting conversations into appointments

Generating and researching new leads

Data mining and maintaining accurate prospect information

Updating call outcomes and client information

Providing daily activity and performance reports

Following JD Life's calling processes, scripts and compliance procedures

What We're Looking For



The successful candidate must:



Have proven outbound telemarketing, cold calling or appointment-setting experience

Be comfortable calling people who have had no previous contact with our company

Have a strong sales mindset and genuine passion for achieving results

Have excellent spoken and written English

Be confident communicating with New Zealand clients and able to adapt to the New Zealand accent and communication style

Be comfortable working towards measurable call and appointment targets

Be organised, reliable and able to work independently

Be confident using computers, spreadsheets/CRM systems and online research tools

Have fast and reliable internet

Have a backup plan for internet or power interruptions, such as a generator, backup connection or access to an alternative workplace

Have a professional noise-cancelling headset and suitable calling environment

Working Hours & Salary



Salary: PHP 20,000 per month

Hours: 8 hours per day, Monday to Friday

Schedule: New Zealand business hours



You must be comfortable starting at approximately 4:00 AM Philippines time / 9:00 AM New Zealand time, subject to New Zealand daylight-saving changes.



What We Offer



You'll be joining an established New Zealand financial advice business with a supportive team and structured processes.



We will provide training on:



Our proven appointment-setting approach

New Zealand client communication

Our products and services

Call handling and objection management

Company systems, procedures and protocols



We are looking for someone who wants to become a long-term member of our team and take pride in consistently producing quality appointments.



PRE-INTERVIEW REQUIREMENT – VOICE RECORDING



Your application will not be considered without a voice recording.



Please record yourself delivering the following script naturally and confidently:



“Good morning/afternoon/evening, my name is (your name), and I am calling on behalf of JD Life.



I believe we can help you maximise your current ACC position by making sure that you are on the correct ACC classification unit and by giving you a free assessment to make sure that you are not overpaying on your ACC levy.



We have a broker around the area, and his role is to pop out and see farms and businesses with regards to their ACC, to show them how it may work for them or sometimes how it may not work for them.



It’s approximately a 20-minute catch-up with no cost and no obligation on your behalf. Would that be of interest to you?”



How to Apply



Please send us:



Your updated CV

Your voice recording using the script above

A short summary of your previous outbound sales/cold-calling experience

Your previous sales or appointment-setting results, if available



NO RECORDING = APPLICATION WILL NOT BE CONSIDERED.



If you have no outbound sales experience or are uncomfortable making cold calls and asking for the appointment, this position is unlikely to be suitable for you.



If you're confident on the phone, enjoy the challenge of converting cold prospects, and have a track record of producing results, we'd love to hear from you.

We are looking for a multifunctional Virtual Assistant who is organized, detail-oriented, proactive, and eager to learn. This is a long-term position for someone who wants to grow with the company and gradually take on more responsibility.

Support daily administrative and operational tasks.

Help build, organize, and maintain company systems and processes.

Create and maintain clear documentation, checklists, SOPs, and workflows.

 What You'll Be Doing

description:
About the Role



We are looking for a highly organized, proactive Legal Virtual Assistant to help manage multiple active California legal matters from start to finish.



This is not simply a document-organizing position. You will help keep every case moving, make sure deadlines are tracked, filings are prepared correctly, supporting evidence is organized, hearings are prepared for in advance, and nothing important falls through the cracks.



The goal is simple: every case should be organized, current, deadline-ready, filing-ready, and hearing-ready at all times.

Responsibilities



You will help manage approximately 10-15 active legal matters and may be responsible for:



Maintaining a master legal tracker showing every case, deadline, hearing, filing, outstanding task, and next action.



Reviewing court orders, minute orders,
s, correspondence, discovery, and case documents and updating the tracker accordingly.



Preparing filing packages, exhibits, declarations, supporting documents, proofs of service, and court forms for review and signature.



Checking court filing requirements, formatting requirements, filing instructions, and procedural deadlines.



Making sure filings are complete before submission, including signatures, attachments, exhibits, captions, case numbers, and required supporting forms.



Monitoring court dockets and identifying newly filed documents, rulings, hearing dates, or changes that require action.



Maintaining organized folders for each case with consistent naming and version control.



Creating hearing preparation packets containing the key filings, orders, evidence, timelines, arguments, and documents needed for the hearing.



Preparing concise case summaries and timelines so the principal can quickly understand the current status of each matter.

Organizing evidence including
s, text messages, recordings, transcripts, photographs, court documents, and other exhibits.



Helping prepare discovery requests, discovery responses, deficiency lists, subpoenas, and supporting materials under direction.



Tracking meet-and-confer deadlines, discovery deadlines, response deadlines, filing deadlines, service deadlines, and hearing dates.



Coordinating signatures, service, electronic filing, document delivery, transcript requests, and other administrative case requirements.



Researching California court procedures, local rules, forms, and filing requirements when requested.



Following up proactively when documents, responses, signatures, court information, or other items are still outstanding.



Maintaining a clear daily list of what is completed, what is pending, what is blocked, and what needs immediate attention.

Hearing Readiness



Every upcoming hearing should be prepared well before the hearing date.



You will help confirm:



What the hearing is about

What orders are currently in effect

What has already been filed

What still needs to be filed

Filing and service deadlines

Important evidence and exhibits

Relevant communications and prior orders

Documents needed during the hearing

Outstanding issues requiring a decision

Follow-up actions after the hearing

You should never wait until the day before a hearing to begin organizing the case.



Filing Readiness



Before any filing is considered ready, you should verify the filing package for completeness and flag anything missing.



This includes checking court forms, captions, case numbers, dates, signatures, exhibits, declarations, attachments, pagination, proofs of service, filing instructions, and supporting documents.



You are not expected to independently practice law or provide legal advice. Your responsibility is to make sure the legal work is organized, researched, documented, reviewed, and operationally ready.



What We Are Looking For



We want someone who is extremely organized, dependable, detail-oriented, comfortable working with large amounts of information, and capable of managing multiple deadlines without constant supervision.



You should be comfortable with Google Drive, Google Docs, Google Sheets, Gmail, PDF documents, online court systems, electronic filing systems, AI tools, legal research, and document management.



Experience with California family law, civil litigation, discovery, restraining-order matters, appeals, or self-represented litigants is a major advantage.



Working Standards



Be online, settled, prepared, and ready before scheduled meetings.



Take ownership of tasks through completion. Do not simply identify a problem and hand it back. Research it, organize what you found, explain what is missing, and propose the next action.



Communicate proactively. Do not disappear when something becomes difficult.



Demonstrate progress before asking questions whenever possible.



Every assigned task should ultimately have a clear status: Completed, Pending, Waiting on Someone, or Blocked, with the next action identified.



Accuracy is extremely important. Never guess about a deadline, court requirement, filing status, or legal fact. Verify it and provide the source.



Success in This Role



You are succeeding when:

No important deadline is missed.

Every case has a clear next action.

Documents can be found immediately.

Filings are prepared ahead of deadlines.

Hearings are organized in advance.

Evidence is properly categorized and accessible.

Outstanding items are actively followed up.

The legal tracker accurately reflects the real status of every matter.

The principal does not need to repeatedly ask what happened or what needs to happen next.



Compensation: $700/month, full-time.

This is intended to be a long-term position for someone who can become the operational owner of the legal case-management process.

REQUIREMENTS

TO APPLY, PLEASE INCLUDE:

title: Coverage Virtual Assistant
description:
About the Role



We are hiring reliable Coverage Virtual Assistants to provide dependable on-call support during assigned coverage hours.



This is a request-based role. You are not expected to continuously monitor systems or stay busy when there is nothing to do.



Instead, you are expected to be available during your assigned shift and respond promptly when a request comes in.

When there are no active requests, you are free to work on other jobs, clients, or projects.



The goal is to provide reliable coverage across the team without requiring someone to sit idle waiting for work.



How the Role Works



During your assigned coverage hours:



Be reachable and available.



Check communication channels when requested or when a new request comes in.



Acknowledge requests promptly.



Handle straightforward requests when appropriate.



Escalate or assign more complex requests to the correct person.



Follow through until the request is either completed or clearly handed off.



Provide a brief handoff at the end of your shift if anything remains open.



When there is no request requiring your attention, you may work on other flexible projects.



Your outside work must not prevent you from responding promptly when needed.



Responsibilities



You may be asked to:



Check
, messages, calendars, documents, systems, or accounts upon request.



Respond to incoming team requests during your shift.



Complete simple administrative or operational tasks.



Make small updates or corrections.



Locate information or documents.



Route requests to the appropriate team member.



Escalate urgent matters quickly.



Follow up on specific outstanding items when asked.



Record important updates for the next person.



Make sure open requests are properly handed off before your shift ends.



Responsiveness Standard



Responsiveness is the most important requirement for this role.



You do not need to spend your entire shift actively watching communication channels.



However, when a request is sent during your assigned coverage hours, you should be reachable, acknowledge it promptly, and begin handling or routing it without unnecessary delay.



If another project regularly prevents you from responding when needed, this role will not be a good fit.



What You Are Not Expected to Do



You are not expected to:



Continuously monitor systems all day.



Create unnecessary work when there are no requests.



Personally complete every complex project.



Stay focused exclusively on our business during quiet periods.



The role is intentionally designed to allow you to work on other flexible projects when our team does not need assistance.

Your Role When a Request Comes In



The process should generally be:



Request Received → Acknowledge → Handle if appropriate → Escalate or assign if needed → Confirm status → Handoff if still open



Complex work will normally be handled by the primary team or specialist responsible for that area.



Shift Handoff



If anything is still open when your shift ends, provide a short handoff including:



What was requested



What has already been done



What is still pending



Whether anything is urgent



Who should handle the next step



The next Coverage VA or team member should be able to pick up the request without starting over.



What We Are Looking For



We want someone who is:



Reliable

Responsive

Organized

Comfortable working independently

Able to follow instructions

Able to recognize urgency

Comfortable escalating instead of guessing

A strong written communicator

Comfortable using Google Workspace, messaging platforms, AI tools, and common business software

Success in This Role



You are succeeding when:



You are available during your assigned coverage hours.



Requests are acknowledged promptly.



Straightforward requests are handled efficiently.



Urgent matters are escalated quickly.



Complex requests reach the correct person.



Nothing important is forgotten during handoffs.



You remain dependable while still having the flexibility to work on other projects during quiet periods.



Compensation: $350/month.



This role is especially well suited for freelancers or virtual assistants who already have flexible work and want an additional long-term on-call position.

title: E-Commerce Store Setup Specialist – Shopify, Walmart & TikTok Shop
description:
## About the Role



We are looking for an experienced **E-Commerce Store Setup Specialist** to help us expand our existing online business across multiple sales channels.



We already have products listed and selling on **Amazon**. Your primary responsibility will be to use our existing product information, images, branding, and business documentation to build and launch our presence on:



* Shopify

* Walmart Marketplace

* TikTok Shop



The goal is to create professional, customer-ready stores that are properly configured and ready to receive orders.



This is primarily a **setup and launch project**, with the possibility of ongoing work afterward.



## Primary Responsibilities



### Shopify Store Setup



Build and configure a professional Shopify store, including:



* Initial Shopify configuration

* Theme setup and customization

* Homepage design

* Product pages

* Collections/categories

* Navigation menus

* About Us page

* Contact page

* FAQ

* Shipping information

* Returns/refund information

* Privacy and policy pages

* Payment configuration

* Shipping settings

* Domain connection

* Mobile optimization

* Basic SEO

* Analytics/pixel setup where applicable



The finished website should look like a legitimate, professional brand—not simply a default Shopify template.



### Product Listings



We already have Amazon listings that can serve as the starting point.



You will:



* Transfer existing product information

* Organize product images

* Improve titles and descriptions where necessary

* Create platform-appropriate product descriptions

* Add variants/SKUs

* Organize products into collections

* Ensure pricing and product information are accurate

* Optimize listings for each platform

* Maintain consistent branding across channels



### Walmart Marketplace



Help establish and configure our Walmart Marketplace presence, including:



* Seller account setup/verification assistance

* Store configuration

* Product listing creation

* Product categorization

* Images and descriptions

* Shipping settings

* Return settings

* Inventory configuration

* Order-management configuration

* Troubleshooting listing errors or rejected products

* Ensuring listings comply with Walmart requirements



Experience with Walmart Seller Center is strongly preferred.



### TikTok Shop



Set up and optimize our TikTok Shop, including:



* TikTok Shop Seller Center configuration

* Business/store profile setup

* Product uploads

* Product descriptions

* Categories

* Shipping settings

* Returns

* Inventory

* Storefront organization

* Linking products to TikTok content

* Basic TikTok Shop optimization



Experience with TikTok Shop in the **United States market** is highly preferred.



### Multi-Channel Integration



We would prefer someone who understands how to connect these systems efficiently rather than managing everything manually.



You should be able to recommend and/or implement the best way to synchronize:



**Amazon + Shopify + Walmart + TikTok Shop**



This may include:



* Inventory synchronization

* SKU consistency

* Order management

* Product feeds

* Shipping workflows

* Pricing updates

* Analytics

* Marketplace integrations/apps



You should be able to explain which tools you recommend and why.



## What We Will Provide



We can provide:



* Existing Amazon product listings

* Product images

* Product information

* Pricing

* SKUs

* Business information

* Branding/logo

* Required business documents

* Access to the necessary platforms



You should be capable of taking this information and independently completing most of the setup without needing detailed instructions for every step.



## Ideal Candidate



We are looking for someone who has **actually launched e-commerce stores before**, not someone who is simply willing to learn Shopify.



Strong candidates should have experience with several of the following:



* Shopify

* Walmart Seller Center

* TikTok Shop Seller Center

* Amazon Seller Central

* Marketplace product listings

* E-commerce integrations

* Inventory synchronization

* Product SEO

* Shopify themes

* Canva/basic graphic design

* Product page optimization

* Google Analytics

* Meta Pixel

* TikTok Pixel

* Shipping and fulfillment configuration



Amazon Seller Central experience is helpful because our existing Amazon listings will serve as a major source for the new stores.



## Project Goals



At the end of the initial project, we expect to have:



**1. Shopify**

A professional, fully functional Shopify website ready to accept orders.



**2. Walmart**

Our Walmart Marketplace account/store properly configured with approved products live or submitted for approval.



**3. TikTok Shop**

A functioning TikTok Shop with products uploaded and the storefront properly configured.



**4. Integration**

A practical system for keeping inventory, SKUs, pricing, and orders organized across the different platforms.



**5. Documentation**

A simple document explaining the setup, integrations used, and anything we need to know to operate the stores afterward.



## IMPORTANT: Application Requirements



Please do not apply if you have only general VA experience.



We specifically want someone with hands-on **e-commerce store setup experience**.



When applying, please answer:



1. How many Shopify stores have you personally built?

2. Please send links/screenshots of Shopify stores you have worked on.

3. Have you personally set up a Walmart Marketplace seller account?

4. Have you personally set up a U.S. TikTok Shop?

5. Have you worked with Amazon Seller Central?

6. Have you transferred Amazon listings to Shopify, Walmart, or TikTok Shop before?

7. What system would you recommend for syncing inventory between Amazon, Shopify, Walmart, and TikTok Shop?

8. Which Shopify apps or tools would you recommend for this project?

9. Approximately how long would you need to complete the initial setup?

10. What would you charge for the complete project?



Please begin your application with the words:



**"MULTI-CHANNEL READY"**



Applications that do not include this phrase may not be reviewed.



## Position Type



**Initial:** Project-based / Part-time



**Potential Future Work:** Store maintenance, product launches, listing optimization, marketplace management, promotions, and e-commerce expansion.



We are interested in building a long-term relationship with the right person as our e-commerce business grows.

title: Long-Term Video Editor for GRiT - Long-form Videos + Social Cutdowns
description:
GRiT is seeking a reliable video editor for an ongoing working relationship. The primary responsibility is to turn raw recordings into polished long-form videos and then repurpose the strongest moments into short-form social content.

This is not a shorts-only position. You must have experience shaping long-form spoken content, improving pacing, removing unnecessary material, and finding compelling moments that work as standalone shorts.

Monthly workload



The initial monthly package will include:

- Two long-form videos per month

- Approximately 10–20 finished minutes per long-form video

- Up to 90 minutes of organized raw footage per episode

- Four vertical shorts derived from each long-form video

- Eight shorts total per month

- Two consolidated revision rounds for each long-form video and its related shorts:  Two reasonable revision rounds are included for each episode package. One episode package consists of the long-form master and its four associated shorts. Revision requests must be consolidated into one list per round. Revisions cover adjustments to the agreed edit—not complete re-edits, replacement footage submitted after editing begins, or a change in creative direction.

- Editable project files

- Long-form responsibilities

Review and organize supplied raw footage

- Remove mistakes, false starts, long pauses and unnecessary repetition

- Create a coherent story with professional pacing

- Clean and level dialogue audio

- Add appropriate music and sound effects

- Perform basic color correction

- Add relevant B-roll, titles and supporting graphics

- Follow GRiT’s brand guidelines

- Export the finished master in horizontal 16:9 format

- Short-form responsibilities



Initial long-form draft delivered within five business days of receiving complete materials. 

Associated shorts delivered within two business days after approval of the long-form master.



After completing the long-form master, you will:

- Identify the strongest standalone moments

- Create compelling openings or hooks

- Reframe footage for vertical 9:16 delivery

- Add accurate, branded captions

- Add B-roll, punch-ins, graphics and sound effects where appropriate

- Keep each short focused on one complete idea

- Export for Instagram Reels, TikTok and YouTube Shorts



Compensation: $400–$600 USD per month, depending on experience, portfolio quality and final scope.

Please provide your proposed monthly rate for this exact workload, even if it differs from the listed range.



Paid trial

Shortlisted candidates will receive the same source footage and instructions. The trial will require:

One polished 2–3 minute horizontal edit

One 30–60 second vertical short derived from that edit

Captions and basic GRiT branding

One revision round

Editable project files

Trial compensation: $50–$75 USD.

Do not create an unpaid sample when applying.



Requirements

Demonstrated experience editing both long-form and short-form content

Strong storytelling and pacing skills

Ability to identify compelling short-form moments within longer recordings

Strong written English and accurate captioning

Experience with Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro or equivalent professional software

Reliable computer and internet connection

Consistent communication and dependable delivery

Ability to follow reference videos and brand guidelines

Willingness to provide editable project files

Properly licensed music, stock footage, fonts and other third-party assets



How to apply

Begin your application with the word GRIT. Include:

Your country and time zone.

Links to one or two long-form videos you personally edited.

Links to three short-form videos you personally edited.

A description of what you completed in each sample.

Your editing software and computer specifications.

Your current weekly availability.

Applications containing only a general showreel, with no complete long-form samples, will not be considered.

title: Marketing Agency Operations Manager — Full-Time Remote
description:
# Operations Manager / Client Success Manager — Full-Time Remote



**Company:** Detailer Ads

**Pay:** $1,250–$1,500 USD/month starting + performance bonuses

**Schedule:** 7 Days Per Week

**Location:** Remote

**Long-Term Pay Potential:** $2,000+/month as responsibilities and company grow



## About Detailer Ads



Detailer Ads is a fast-growing marketing agency that helps auto detailing businesses across the United States generate leads and book more jobs through paid advertising.



We currently manage 30+ active clients and are looking for a highly organized and responsible **Operations Manager** to take ownership of our day-to-day agency operations.



This is NOT a basic virtual assistant position.



We are looking for someone who can manage clients, manage team members, solve problems independently, keep projects moving, and make sure the agency runs smoothly without the owner needing to be involved in daily fulfillment.



Your primary goal:



**Make sure every client is taken care of, every task gets completed, and nothing falls through the cracks.**



---



# Schedule



This is a **full-time position with 7-day-per-week responsibility.**



Our clients operate businesses every day of the week, so we need someone who can monitor operations and client communication throughout the week.



### Monday–Friday



These will be your primary working days.



You will actively:



* Manage clients

* Manage the team

* Check projects

* Follow up on overdue tasks

* Coordinate campaigns

* Coordinate creatives

* Handle onboarding

* Resolve client issues



### Saturday–Sunday



Weekends will generally be lighter.



You will primarily:



* Check Slack/client messages

* Handle urgent client issues

* Make sure nothing important is being missed

* Follow up when necessary

* Check that campaigns and operations are running normally



You will not necessarily be doing a full workload every Saturday and Sunday, but you must be **reliable and reachable throughout the week.**



---



# Your Responsibilities



## 1. Client Communication



You will become the primary point of contact for our clients.



Clients communicate with us primarily through Slack.



You will:



* Respond to client questions

* Provide updates

* Follow up with clients

* Handle normal concerns

* Request missing information

* Follow up for video footage

* Communicate campaign updates

* Identify clients who may be unhappy or at risk of canceling



The owner should NOT need to answer routine client questions.



You should be able to handle most situations independently.



---



# 2. Manage Our Fulfillment Team



You will help manage our existing:



* Onboarding VA

* Video Editor

* Media Buyer



And future team members as the agency grows.



You are responsible for making sure everyone knows:



**What needs to be completed**



**Who is responsible**



**When it needs to be completed**



**What has the highest priority**



If someone misses a deadline, you follow up.



If something is blocking a client, you solve it.



The owner should not need to constantly check whether employees completed their work.



---



# 3. Manage New Client Onboarding



Every new client should move through our system:



Payment Received



↓



Onboarding Form Completed



↓



Meta Access Received



↓



GoHighLevel Setup



↓



Scripts Created



↓



Client Records Footage



↓



Footage Sent to Editor



↓



Ads Edited



↓



Campaign Built



↓



Campaign Live



Your responsibility is to make sure clients continue moving through this process.



No client should sit forgotten for several days because someone failed to follow up.



---



# 4. Manage Creative Production



You will coordinate between:



**Client → Video Editor → Media Buyer**



You will:



* Make sure clients receive scripts

* Follow up for video footage

* Organize submitted footage

* Assign editing priorities

* Monitor the editing queue

* Make sure videos are completed on time

* Review advertisements for obvious mistakes

* Send approved creatives to the media buyer



Our video editor should always know exactly what needs to be edited next.



---



# 5. Coordinate With Our Media Buyer



You do NOT need to personally run
 Ads.



However, you should understand the basics of Meta advertising.



You will communicate with our media buyer to ensure:



* Campaigns launch on time

* Clients receive leads

* Underperforming clients are identified

* New creatives are requested when necessary

* Campaign issues are addressed

* No advertising account gets forgotten



---



# 6. Keep Our Agency Organized



You will maintain our internal operations system.



Every client should always have a clear status.



For example:



???? ACTIVE



???? NEEDS ATTENTION



???? AT RISK



Or:



ONBOARDING



WAITING FOR ACCESS



WAITING FOR FOOTAGE



EDITING



READY TO LAUNCH



LIVE



NEEDS NEW CREATIVE



You should be able to answer:



**"What's happening with this client?"**



without needing to ask multiple people first.



---



# Tools We Use



Experience with these tools is preferred:



* Slack

* GoHighLevel

* Meta Business Manager

*
 Ads Manager

* ClickUp

* Google Drive

* Google Sheets

* Zapier

* Stripe



You do not need to already know every platform.



However, you MUST be comfortable learning software quickly.



---



# Who We're Looking For



We want someone who:



* Has previous marketing agency experience

* Has managed clients before

* Has managed remote workers before

* Has excellent written English

* Is comfortable communicating with U.S. clients

* Is extremely organized

* Responds quickly

* Can manage 30+ clients

* Can manage multiple priorities simultaneously

* Takes ownership

* Can solve problems independently

* Doesn't require constant instructions

* Notices problems before the owner does

* Can hold team members accountable

* Is dependable 7 days per week



Most importantly:



### We need someone who THINKS like a manager — not someone who simply waits for tasks.



---



# You Are NOT a Good Fit If:



* You need instructions for every decision

* You only want simple VA work

* You regularly disappear during working hours

* You don't like communicating with clients

* You avoid difficult conversations

* You struggle managing multiple priorities

* You miss deadlines

* You need constant reminders

* You blame other people when something goes wrong

* You are unavailable every weekend



---



# What Success Looks Like

title: Apparel Graphic Designer (Hand Illustration) for US Coastal Lifestyle Brand. Paid Test Project, Then Ongoing Work.
description:
I run ATEOTD, a coastal lifestyle apparel brand in the US. Think of brands like Vuori, Faherty, and Quicksilver: quiet, premium, restrained. Small placements, limited ink colors, nothing loud.



The brand has a second layer. Our phrases come from scripture, but they are chosen so that a stranger with no faith background would read them as simply well written. We never print verse citations on garments. If a design feels "churchy," it has failed. If it feels like a great vintage surf graphic that happens to carry weight, it has succeeded.



I am hiring one illustrator, starting with a single paid test design. If the work is strong, this becomes ongoing per-design work. I only run one design at a time, and I am honest with you up front: I am picky. What I offer in return is clear briefs, fast decisions, and steady work if we fit.



The Work



Hand-illustrated graphic tees. Surf, and minimal coastal styles. Designs print DTG on garment-dyed tees, so:



Maximum 2 to 3 ink colors per design

No fine details below roughly 1.5mm (they will not print reliably)

Designs must work on muted garment colors (dusty blue, khaki, seafoam)



Hard Requirements



No AI-generated artwork. None. Not as a base, not "cleaned up," not for reference compositing. Original illustration only. I will ask to see process work (sketches, WIP screenshots) and I check.



Editable source files. Layered Adobe Illustrator files (vector, with both outlined and live-text versions where type is used), plus print-ready PNG at 300 DPI on transparent background.



You must be comfortable working from written briefs in English.



Sample Brief (this is the actual test design)



Phrase: "Let the sea roar"



Direction: A contained emblem in the retro surf style: an ocean scene built from flat, layered organic shapes inside an arch frame. A breaking wave as the focal point, a low sun, and a simple horizon. Four flat ink colors maximum, drawn from a muted coastal palette (dusty blue, sage, ochre, cream). No gradients, no outlines doing heavy lifting, no fine detail. The phrase is part of the lockup, either arced along the inside of the frame or set beneath the scene like a badge, never floating as a caption. A slight handmade quality at the edges is welcome; sterile vector perfection is not. Back print, roughly 10 to 12 inches tall



Three links to hand-illustrated apparel or print work you made (not a full portfolio dump, your three best)

Two or three sentences on your illustration process, including what tools you draw in

Confirmation that you understand and agree to the no-AI rule

How many days you would need for the test design



Applications that skip these steps will not get a reply.
