title: Direct Response Video Editor (VSLs + AI Cartoon Videos and other AI style ads + Short form videos)
description:
Hiring: Direct Response Video Editor (VSLs + AI Cartoon Videos and other AI style ads + Short form videos)



DTC / dropshipping brand doing ~$200k/month in revenue



Role: Video Editor / AI Video Producer Type:



Read this part first



We are not looking for someone to "make our videos look nice."



We are looking for someone who understands that a video's job is to hold attention and make people buy — and who can build that video end to end, including sourcing or generating every frame of footage inside it.



If you need a folder of assets handed to you before you can start editing, this role isn't for you. If you can take a script and a product and come back with a finished, conversion-ready asset, keep reading.



Who we are



We're a direct response DTC brand currently doing around $200k/month, almost entirely on the back of paid media and creative. Creative is our growth lever. Not the site, not the offer tweaks, not the
 flows — the video.



That means the editor seat is one of the highest-leverage roles in the company. When a video wins here, it wins loudly and you'll see it in the numbers within days.



We're scaling, and we want to stop stitching together freelancers per project. We want one highly skilled person who becomes part of the team, learns our angles and our customer inside out, and gets sharper with every batch we ship.



How this role starts (please read carefully)



This does not begin as a full-time position, and that's deliberate.



We start every editor on a lighter workload — a smaller number of videos per week — for the first stretch. Not because we're testing whether you can hold a job, but because we want to see how you fit: how you take feedback, how you handle a script we hand you, how you communicate when something's unclear, and whether the work holds up once the novelty wears off. It also gives you time to learn our customer, our angles, and what a "winning" video looks like in our account specifically.



From there it scales. As the fit proves out and your creatives start performing, the volume goes up, the pay goes up, and the arrangement moves toward a secure, permanent full-time seat — with a defined monthly retainer rather than per-project work.



To be clear about what we're offering:



Phase 1 — Fit: Lower volume, paid per project or at a smaller retainer. Heavy feedback from us. We're both figuring out if this works.

Phase 2 — Ramp: Volume increases, you take on the VSLs and the AI cartoon projects with less hand-holding, pay increases accordingly.

Phase 3 — In-house: Full-time, secure retainer, you own the creative pipeline and have real input on direction. Room to grow into a creative lead as we bring on more editors.



We're not looking for someone to fill a gap for three months. We're looking for the person who's still here in two years running our creative. The slow start is how we get there without either of us wasting the other's time.



If you need immediate full-time income from day one, this probably isn't the right fit right now — and that's fine, just be upfront about it.



What you'll actually be making

1. Long-form VSLs (Video Sales Letters)



The core of the role. 2–7+ minute sales videos built off scripts we provide.



You'll be responsible for:



Pacing the entire video so retention doesn't collapse — pattern interrupts, cuts, zooms, motion, sound design, text emphasis, visual proof

Sourcing your own b-roll. Stock libraries, licensed footage, UGC-style clips, screen recordings, archival, whatever the script calls for. You find it. You don't ask us to send it. In some cases we will also provide clips and we have a bunch of softwares that you can use to make this process easier aswell.



Generating AI video to fill the gaps stock can't cover — visualizing mechanisms, metaphors, before/after states, scenarios that don't exist as footage.



Building the visual language for a section, not just laying clips over a voiceover



Kinetic text, callouts, subtitles, on-screen proof elements, testimonial treatments



Sound design and music that carries emotional beats without burying the VO



2. AI cartoon / animated videos (short form AND long form)



We're producing a growing volume of fully AI-generated animated content — story-driven ads, explainer content, character-led narratives.



You'll take a script and:



Build a consistent character and world (this is the hard part — character consistency across dozens of shots is a real skill and we'll be testing for it)

Generate the shots yourself using AI image + video tools

Handle lip sync, voiceover, and audio

Cut it into a video that actually flows as a story rather than a slideshow of AI clips

Deliver in both short form (15–60s, vertical) and long form formats

3. Short form paid ads



Hook-first ads for Meta / TikTok. High volume, fast iteration. Multiple hook variants of the same body. You'll be cutting these constantly, and you'll be expected to have opinions about which hooks are worth testing.



What we need you to be good at



Non-negotiable:



Editing that converts, not just editing that looks good. You understand hooks, retention curves, pattern interrupts, why the first 3 seconds d
 everything, and how to build toward a CTA. If you've never thought about a video in terms of watch time or CPA, you're not ready for this seat.

Sourcing your own footage. Independently. You know where to find good b-roll,

Generating AI video yourself. Not "willing to learn" — actually doing it now. You know how to prompt, how to iterate when a generation is wrong, how to maintain consistency, and how to upscale and clean up output so it doesn't look like AI slop.

Strong technical craft — clean cuts, deliberate pacing, proper audio levels, colour that matches across mixed sources, subtitles that don't look like an afterthought.

Speed. We ship a lot. Quality at volume is the whole game.

Ownership. You get a script and a brief and come back with a finished asset. You flag problems early. You don't go quiet for four days.



Tools — you should be fluent in most of these or their equivalents:



Editing: Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, or CapCut.

AI video: Higgsfield, Veo, Kling, Runway, Sora, Hailuo, Seedance — or whatever you've found works better

AI image: Midjourney, Flux, Nano Banana, Ideogram

Voice: ElevenLabs or similar

Upscaling / cleanup: Topaz, Magnific

Bonus: Descript, Adobe Podcast, motion graphics templating, basic scripting/automation for batching

Removing text from video: Vmake



Nice to have:



You've written or restructured direct response scripts before

You've worked on offers in health and wellnes niche

You can take a competitor's winning ad, break down why it works, and build a better version

You track what's new in AI video weekly because you find it genuinely interesting

Who this is NOT for

Editors who only work from supplied assets

People who see AI tools as a threat or a gimmick

"Cinematic" editors who make beautiful videos that don't sell

Anyone who needs to be chased for updates

Agencies or people who'll pass the work to a junior. We want the person doing the work.

What you get

A real seat on a growing team. We start light on purpose, but the destination is a secure full-time role — and if it works, we build our creative operation around you.

Direct feedback loop on your work. You'll see spend, retention data, and CPA on the creatives you cut. Most editors never get this — it's the fastest way to get genuinely good.

Budget for tools and subscriptions. We're not going to bottleneck you over a $50/mo AI credit plan.

Performance bonuses when your creative becomes a winner.

Room to grow into a creative lead role as we scale and bring on more editors under you.

Fast decisions. Small team. No layers of approval.

How to apply



Please follow this exactly — it's the first filter.



Send your portfolio. We want to see, specifically:

At least one long-form VSL or long-form sales video you cut

At least one AI-generated video you produced yourself (cartoon/animated preferred)

Short form paid ads if you have them

For 2–3 of those videos, tell us in one or two lines each: what the goal was, what you did to hold attention, and any performance numbers you're allowed to share (spend, ROAS, retention, CTR — whatever you have).

Tell us your AI stack. Which tools you use for what, and one problem you've solved with them that most people get wrong.

Your rate and your realistic capacity — how many long-form videos and how many short form ads per week.

Turnaround time on a typical 10-minute VSL, assuming script and VO are provided.

Confirm you're okay with the ramp-up structure — starting at lower volume and building toward full-time. One line is enough.

title: Recruiting Assistant for US Dental Practice — Indeed Screening & Scheduling (15 hrs/week, Long-Term)
description:
About us



We are a growing 15-operatory dental practice in the United States with multiple doctors. We hire regularly for front-office and clinical support roles, and our job applications come in through Indeed. We need someone reliable to own that inbox.



This is a long-term position. We are not looking for someone between gigs — we want someone who will still be with us in two years.



What you will do



This job is about outreach and getting good candidates in front of us quickly. In order of importance:



Respond fast. Monitor our Indeed inbox daily and keep it at zero unread. Experienced applicants get a reply within 12 hours, everyone else within 24. Speed is the whole job — good dental candidates are hired within days.

Follow up rather than waiting. Most people don't reply the first time and aren't ignoring us. You'll work a simple follow-up cadence, and a large share of our interviews will come from it.

Work the candidates we already have. Everyone who ever applied to us is still in our account. Once a month you'll go back through older applicants and re-contact anyone worth another look.

Schedule interviews. Using Indeed's scheduling tool and the interview times we give you each week — no need to check back with us for each one.

Send interview reminders. Text or WhatsApp the doctor and our office manager the day before every interview.

Answer routine applicant questions from a prepared FAQ, and send polite declines to those who aren't a fit.

Send us one short end-of-day summary: who applied, who you advanced, who needs our decision.



Also, but not the focus:



Post our job ads using the text we provide — we write them, you publish them as written

Repost our free listings before they expire (they lapse at about 30 days, silently)

Tell us which ads aren't producing, and suggest improvements if you see them — we'll d
 whether to change the wording



What you will NOT do



No patient information of any kind. You will never have access to patient records.

No final hiring decisions. You screen and organize; we d
.

No phone calls. All candidate contact is written and happens inside Indeed's messaging system — you will never need our
 accounts or phone numbers to talk to a candidate. (You will text or WhatsApp us directly, but only about scheduling and reminders — never a candidate.)

No spending. You will never enter payment information or set a sponsored-job budget. Our ads run free by default; if one needs paid promotion, you flag it and we approve it in writing.

No writing our ads. We provide the text; you post it as written. You're welcome to suggest improvements — a sentence, not a project — and we'll d
.



Requirements



Excellent written English. You will be writing to job applicants in our voice, and they must never be able to tell the message came from outside our office.

Detail-oriented with recurring deadlines. Several of our job ads expire monthly and must be reposted before they lapse — this is the kind of task that quietly stops happening if someone isn't watching it.

Persistent. A lot of this role is following up with people who didn't reply the first time, and going back to candidates from months ago. If that feels like nagging to you, this isn't the right fit.

2+ years of virtual assistant, recruiting, HR, or customer support experience

Comfortable making judgment calls from a written rubric rather than asking about every single case

Reliable internet and a working computer

Available to start within two weeks



Nice to have (not required)



Prior experience with Indeed's employer dashboard, writing job postings, or any applicant tracking system

Experience supporting a US-based medical or dental office



How to apply



Send a message with the subject line: Recruiting Assistant — [your first name] — Hillcrest



In the body, include:



A short paragraph on the most similar work you have done

Your answer to this question: An applicant messages asking "is this position still available?" three days after applying, and you can see they were already marked as declined. Write the exact reply you would send them.

The word operatory somewhere in your message so we know you read the full post



Applications missing any of these three items will not be reviewed.

Brand & Digital Support

Create/update Canva templates and maintain brand consistency

Assist with occasional website,
, digital, and presentation graphics

Retouch and prepare product photography as needed

Maintain organized source files, assets, naming conventions, and versions



Required Skills

Strong professional graphic design portfolio

Excellent Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, and InDesign skills

Strong Canva skills and experience with Procreate or similar illustration software

Demonstrated packaging and print design experience

Strong knowledge of print production and professional printing/manufacturing files

Strong typography, layout, color, and visual hierarchy

Excellent attention to detail, organization, and written/verbal communication

Experience designing for consumer products, home fragrance, beauty, wellness, gifting, lifestyle, food/beverage, or other premium physical-product brands is preferred.

Hours & Availability

Remote and generally flexible

To Apply

title: Full-Time Accountability & Motivation Partner (8 Hrs/Day, Camera-On, US Eastern Hours)
description:
Full-Time Accountability & Motivation Partner (8 Hrs/Day, Camera-On, US Eastern Hours)



Type: Full-Time (8 hours/day, 6 days/week — open to 5.5 days/week for the right candidate) Pay: $2.00–$3.00 USD/hour base — $4.00–$5.00/hour available for candidates who can also take on content creation, meeting notes, and video editing (see below) Schedule: US Eastern Time business hours (exact start/end time discussed at interview) Start: ASAP



About the Role



This is not a typical virtual assistant job. I don't need someone to answer
s or do research — I need someone whose full-time job is to keep me motivated, focused, and on track for an entire 8-hour workday.



You'll be on a live video call with your camera on, working alongside me for the whole shift — like a virtual work partner. Your main role is to keep my energy up, keep me accountable to my deadlines, and make sure I'm actually working hard throughout the day instead of getting distracted. On top of that, you'll help keep my schedule and to-do list organized so nothing slips through the cracks.



If you're naturally encouraging, love holding people accountable, and have great spoken English, this could be a great fit. And if you can also help with content creation and video editing, there's meaningfully higher pay available — see the Bonus Skills section below.



Responsibilities

Join a live video call (camera on) with me for the full 8-hour shift, every workday

Start each day with a short kickoff call to set the day's priorities and goals

Check in throughout the day with encouragement, motivation, and reminders to keep me focused and working

Track my daily to-do list and deadlines, and give me nudges before things are due

Speak up — respectfully but directly — when I'm procrastinating, off track, or slipping on a deadline

Do a short end-of-day wrap-up: what got done, what's still open, what's due next

Keep a simple daily log of tasks completed vs. planned so we can track progress over time

Bonus Skills (Higher Pay Available — $4–$5/hr)



If you can also handle any of the following, let me know in your application — it moves you into the higher pay range:



Content creation — helping write, plan, or produce content for me (posts, scripts, captions, etc.)

Meeting recordings & notes — recording my calls/meetings and turning them into clean summaries or notes

Video editing — basic editing skills (e.g., CapCut, Premiere, Descript, or similar) to cut and polish video content



You don't need all three — even one of these skills, done well, is valuable and worth discussing a higher rate for.



Requirements

Fluent, clear English — spoken and written. This is essential since the job is almost entirely verbal communication.

Extremely responsible and reliable — this role depends on you showing up every day, on time, for the full shift

Highly organized — comfortable keeping a calendar and to-do list (Google Calendar, Trello, Asana, or similar)

A naturally positive, energetic, motivating personality — someone who's genuinely good at encouraging people and holding them accountable

Comfortable being on camera for extended periods

Stable high-speed internet, a working webcam and microphone, and a quiet environment for calls

Available full-time (8 hrs/day) during US Eastern business hours

Prior experience as a VA, accountability coach, executive assistant, or similar is a plus, but not required — attitude and reliability matter more than experience

How to Apply



To show me you read the full posting, please start your application with the word "MOTIVATED" in the subject line.



In your application, please include:



A short voice or video introduction (1–2 minutes) so I can hear your spoken English and energy

Answers to these two questions:

Why do you think you'd be good at motivating and holding someone accountable every day?

title: Customer Service Representative
description:
Customer Service Agent — Logistics Company (Remote, Long-Term)

We're hiring a world-class customer service agent to be the front line for our clients. This is a long-term role for the right person — if you're fast, sharp, and take pride in flawless service, we want to talk to you.

The role



Long-term position, starting with a 2-week paid test period and evaluation, followed by a second evaluation after the first month. Do well and we're looking to keep you on board for the long run.

Schedule (36 hours/week, 6 days a week):



Weekdays: 4 hours per day, 4:00 PM /5:00 PM – 8:00 PM / 9:00 PM Aruba time (AST, GMT-4). You pick one day off, Wednesday, or Thursday.

Saturday & Sunday: 3 hours, 5:00 PM – 8:00 PM Aruba time. Weekends are required.

Tuesdays we do have a meeting from 9:20 AM to 10:20 AM Aruba time, this is a required meeting.





Pay: $4–$7 USD/hour, based on experience and how you perform during the test weeks.



What you'll do



Answer client messages across WhatsApp,
, and chat quickly and accurately

Resolve questions about packages, shipping, pricing, and account issues

Keep responses clear, friendly, and professional

Escalate the right issues at the right time and follow up until they're closed

Pitch in on other tasks. When the inbox is clear and all clients are answered, you'll help out with other tasks — no "that's not my job" attitude here.

Make us better. This isn't just an inbox job. You'll help build out our knowledge base, flag patterns worth fixing, and proactively suggest ways to level up our customer service — from response templates to workflow improvements to ideas we haven't thought of yet.



What we're looking for



Fast and smart. You think on your feet, learn our systems quickly, and don't need to be told twice.

Exceptionally smart — and able to prove it. Cum Laude or Summa Cum Laude graduates are strongly preferred. But if you don't have the honors title and know you're still in the top tier, show us: top exam scores, a standout portfolio, an impressive project, a hard-won achievement — whatever demonstrates you're genuinely one of the sharpest people we'll talk to.

Strong English is essential. You need to write and speak English at a high level — clear and professional. Sounding natural is a big plus. Spanish is a plus too.

Excellent written communication — polished, warm, and error-free.



Required — strong, demonstrated AI fluency. This is core to the role. You already use AI daily and know how to make it work for customer service: drafting fast, accurate replies, translating between languages, summarizing long threads, and holding a consistent tone at scale. To confirm you've read this far, please begin your application with the words "I Love Logistics." You should move faster and deliver higher quality because of how you use AI, not in spite of it.

A paid AI assistant account (ChatGPT Plus, Claude Pro, or equivalent) is a plus. Not required, and not reimbursed at this time.



To apply

make a video with this link: 



Hope to meet our awesome Customer Service agent soon.

title: Experienced Short-Form Content Clipper & Social Media Distribution Specialist
description:
Part-Time, Possibly Long-Term



Hours



Approximately 15–20 hours per week

Flexible schedule, but deadlines must be met consistently.



Starting Compensation



$400–$600 USD per month, based on experience, portfolio quality, editing ability, and speed.



There will be opportunities for increased pay and responsibility based on performance.



About the Position



We are looking for an experienced social media content clipper who can turn long-form business, entrepreneurship, marketing, personal-development, and educational content into engaging short-form videos.



This is not an entry-level position.



You must have previous experience clipping long-form videos, podcasts, interviews, livestreams, or training videos into content for:



* Instagram Reels

* TikTok

* YouTube Shorts

*
 Reels

* LinkedIn



We do not want someone who only knows how to add captions to a video.



We need someone who understands how to find strong moments, create better hooks, keep viewers watching, and distribute content correctly across multiple platforms.



Your Responsibilities



You will be responsible for:



* Reviewing long-form videos, trainings, livestreams, interviews, and podcasts

* Independently finding the strongest and most valuable moments

* Creating 10–15 high-quality short-form clips per week

* Writing or improving the opening hook

* Removing pauses, filler words, and unnecessary sections

* Adding clean, accurate, branded captions

* Adding relevant B-roll, images, zooms, graphics, music, and sound effects when needed

* Formatting videos vertically in 9:16

* Creating platform-specific titles and captions

* Writing YouTube Shorts titles and descriptions

* Selecting relevant keywords and hashtags

* Creating or selecting strong thumbnail/cover frames

* Scheduling and publishing approved content

* Organizing edited videos and project files

* Tracking what has been posted on each platform

* Reviewing basic performance data such as views, retention, shares, saves, and comments

* Recommending new hooks, topics, and content angles based on performance



You may receive timestamps for some videos, but you must also be able to watch long-form content and identify strong clips without being given timestamps.



Required Experience



To be considered, you must have:



* At least two years of short-form video editing or content-clipping experience

* A portfolio showing clips created from long-form content

* Experience with TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, or
 Reels

* Strong English comprehension

* The ability to understand business, marketing, entrepreneurship, and personal-development content

* A strong understanding of hooks, pacing, storytelling, and viewer retention

* Experience using CapCut Pro, Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or similar software

* Experience writing social media captions and titles

* Reliable internet and a computer capable of editing video

* Excellent organization and communication skills

* The ability to meet weekly deadlines without constant reminders

* The ability to receive feedback and make revisions quickly



Portfolio Requirements



Your portfolio must include at least four relevant short-form videos.



At least two examples must show:



1. The original long-form video or source content

2. The short-form clip you created from that content

3. Your exact role in creating the finished video

4. The platform where the clip was published

5. Any available performance results, such as views, retention, shares, or saves



Please do not send wedding videos, music videos, gaming montages, or unrelated corporate videos.



We want to see talking-head, podcast, interview, educational, or personal-brand content.



Applications without a relevant portfolio will not be reviewed.



## What Makes Someone Successful in This Role?



The right person:



* Knows how to find the “gold” inside a long video

* Can recognize a strong hook within seconds

* Understands why people stop scrolling

* Uses effects to support the message instead of distracting from it

* Can match an existing brand style

* Checks captions for spelling and accuracy

* Understands that each platform may require a different title, caption, or opening

* Pays attention to performance and improves future clips

* Communicates early if there is a problem or delay

* Wants a reliable, long-term position



## How to Apply



Start your application with:



**MOMENTUM CLIPPER**



Then answer all the following questions:



1. How many years have you edited short-form social media content?

2. Send links to four of your best short-form clips.

3. For at least two clips, include the original long-form source.

4. Which parts of those clips did you personally complete?

5. Which editing software do you use?

6. Which social media scheduling or publishing tools have you used?

7. Have you managed posting across TikTok, Instagram,
, LinkedIn, or YouTube?

8. How many polished clips can you produce each week?

9. What is your normal turnaround time?

10. What is your expected monthly salary?

11. Share your internet speed and computer specifications.

12. In three sentences or fewer, explain how you identify a strong moment inside a long video.

13. Share one short-form video that performed well and explain why you believe it worked.



Also submit a 60–90 second introduction video. Tell us about your experience and why you are a strong fit for this position.



Generic or incomplete applications will not be reviewed.



Hiring Process



Qualified candidates will be invited to complete a small paid editing test.



For the test, you will receive a piece of long-form content and be asked to:



* Select one strong moment

* Edit one short-form video

* Write a hook

* Prepare a caption and title

* Explain which platforms you would publish it on



The test will help us evaluate your judgment, editing quality, communication, and ability to follow instructions.



This is a long-term opportunity for someone who wants consistent work, clear expectations, creative input, and room to grow.





**YOU WILL NOT BE CONSIDERED IF YOU DO NOT PROVIDE A PORTFOLIO OF EXAMPLES AS REQUESTED OR HAVE NO EXPERIENCE**

title: Virtual Assistant – Content Research, Social Media, E-Commerce & AI
description:
I run multiple online businesses and social media/YouTube projects, and I’m looking for a reliable Virtual Assistant to work with me long-term.



I am NOT looking for someone who only follows instructions or performs basic data-entry tasks.



I’m looking for someone who can research independently, think critically, organize information clearly, solve problems, and make recommendations without needing constant direction.



The position will initially be around 10–20 hours per week, with the possibility of increasing hours over time if we work well together.



Main Responsibilities

1. Content & Trend Research



A major part of this role will involve researching content for YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, and other social media projects.



I am not looking for someone who simply searches Google or YouTube and sends me a list of links.



For example, if I give you a topic such as:



“Things that surprise foreigners about Japan”



I may ask you to:



Find relevant TikTok, Instagram, YouTube Shorts, or other social media posts

Identify specific moments that could be useful in a video

Provide the original source URL

Provide timestamps when applicable

Summarize what is being said or shown

Explain why each source is useful

Think about how multiple sources could be organized into an interesting story

VERY IMPORTANT: Original Sources



For this type of research, I am specifically looking for first-hand content posted by the actual person featured in the video on their own social media account.



For example:



A foreigner posts a TikTok about their experience traveling in Japan

→ YES



A foreigner posts an Instagram Reel comparing Japan with their home country

→ YES



A foreigner posts a YouTube Short about something that surprised them in Japan

→ YES



However:



A YouTuber interviews foreigners and uploads the edited interview to their own channel

→ NO



A compilation using other people’s videos

→ NO



A repost account

→ NO



A video that has already been clipped, subtitled, or edited by a third party

→ NO



You may use compilations or reposts to DISCOVER interesting content, but your job is to trace the content back to the original creator and original post whenever possible.



The ability to find and verify original sources is very important for this position.



2. Social Media Management



You may also help manage TikTok, Instagram, YouTube Shorts, and other social accounts.



Tasks may include:



Preparing and scheduling posts

Writing captions

Hashtag and keyword research

Competitor research

Trend research

Content idea generation

Basic analytics

Suggesting improvements and experiments



I am looking for someone who can think beyond simply posting content.



I want someone who asks:



Why did this video perform well?

What are competitors doing differently?

What should we test next?



3. Short-Form Video Editing



You may help edit TikToks, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.



Typical tasks may include:



Cutting footage

Adding subtitles

Adding music

Organizing source footage

Basic effects

Repurposing content into short-form videos



You do NOT need to be a professional-level video editor.



Understanding social media content, working efficiently, and being able to create clean short-form videos are more important.



4. E-Commerce Support



You may also help with businesses on platforms such as Etsy, eBay, Shopify, and Amazon.



Tasks may include:



Product research

Competitor research

Product titles and descriptions

Keyword/tag research

Pricing research

Organizing product information

Preparing listings

Managing information in Google Sheets

5. AI & Automation



You should be comfortable using AI tools such as:



ChatGPT

Claude

Gemini



I am especially interested in people who know how to use AI to improve the quality and speed of their work.



Experience with any of the following is a BIG PLUS:



Make

n8n

Zapier

APIs

Web scraping

Python / JavaScript

Google Sheets automation



Programming experience is NOT required, but automation skills are highly valued.



What I Care About Most



Years of experience are not the most important thing to me.



I care more about whether you can:



Work independently

Research deeply

Trace information back to original sources

Organize information clearly

Understand social media content

Solve problems independently

Use AI effectively

Communicate quickly and reliably



For example, if I tell you:



“Research our competitors and tell me which product we should launch.”



I do NOT want someone who simply sends me five competitor links.



I want someone who can:



Research → Compare → Organize the information → Explain the reasoning → Recommend what we should do



If you encounter something you don’t know, I prefer that you first research the problem, consider possible solutions, and then come to me with your findings and recommendation rather than immediately asking me what to do.



Work Details

Fully remote

Initially 10–20 hours per week

Long-term position

Starting rate: CA$6/hour

Working hours will be agreed upon together

Reliable communication during agreed working hours is required



Hours and compensation may increase over time depending on performance, ability, and workload.



How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



A short introduction about yourself

Relevant work experience

Social media management experience, including accounts you have managed and any measurable results if available

Examples of videos you have edited

Examples of research work you have done

AI tools you regularly use

title: TikTok Shop Manager — Division Lead | Affiliate Programs + GMV Max
description:
READ THIS FIRST



We are not hiring a virtual assistant. We are hiring the person who will run an entire division.



ABOUT US




 is one of the world's first agentic marketplace management agencies. We run TikTok Shop, Amazon, and emerging marketplace channels for premium brands - and we do it with AI agents embedded in every layer of our workflow. Our clients come to us because we move faster and see more than traditional agencies do.



That only works when the people running our accounts are genuinely exceptional. We are onboarding a new tier of top-shelf clients, and we need a leader for our Marketplace Management division.



THE ROLE



You will own our marketplace management division end to end: the clients, the standards, the systems, and eventually the team. This is a senior seat with real authority, reporting directly to leadership.



If you are currently the best operator at your agency and you are tired of waiting for someone above you to move - this is that seat.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN



- Full ownership of TikTok Shop accounts for our premium clients, from strategy through execution

- Shop setup, catalog and listing architecture, compliance, and shop health metrics

- Paid strategy across TikTok Shop Ads, GMV Max, LIVE, and shoppable video

- Affiliate and creator programs: recruitment, negotiation, commission structure, sample seeding, and performance management

- Client relationships - reporting, forecasting, QBRs, and being the calm, credible voice in the room when something goes sideways

- Building the SOPs and playbooks that let this division scale without quality slipping

- Hiring, training, and managing specialists as we grow



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



Required:

- 3+ years managing TikTok Shop accounts hands-on. Not adjacent to them. Not "familiar with" them.

- A track record of scaling GMV that you can describe in real numbers

- Agency or multi-client experience - you can hold five stakeholders at once without dropping anything

- Relentless follow-through. Nothing goes silent on your watch, ever.

- Excellent written and spoken English. This role is client-facing at a senior level.

- AI-forward by default. You already use ChatGPT, Claude, or similar every single day and you can show us exactly how.



Strong bonus:

- Deep creator outreach experience and an existing network

- Affiliate program management at scale

- Amazon Seller Central or Vendor Central experience

- Experience building or leading a team

- Familiarity with agentic tooling - n8n, Make, Zapier, custom GPTs, Claude Projects, MCP



WHAT WE OFFER



- $2,000 - $3,000/month depending on experience

- Full-time, long-term, with a clear path to Head of Division

- Direct access to leadership. No bureaucracy, no politics, no waiting.

- A front-row seat building an agency in a category that did not exist two years ago

- Paid time off and performance bonuses tied to division results

- We invest in your tooling and your training. You will get sharper here.



HOW TO APPLY - PLEASE READ CAREFULLY



Start your application with the word ORBIT so we know you actually read this.



Then answer these four questions briefly and directly:



1. Which TikTok Shop accounts have you managed? Include the category, rough monthly GMV, and how long you ran them.

2. Describe one specific thing you did that moved a client's numbers. What was the before, what did you do, what was the after?

3. What AI tools are in your daily workflow, and what specifically do you use them for?

4. What is your current availability, and how soon could you be full-time with us?



Please do not send a generic resume blast. We read every application that follows these instructions, and we ignore every one that does not.

title: Creative Content & Digital Asset Manager
description:
Job Description – Creative Content & Digital Asset Manager



Full-Time Remote Position



About Space Art Cabinetry:



Space Art Cabinetry is a growing custom cabinetry company specializing in kitchens, custom closets, and other cabinetry and storage solutions.

Every project we design and complete creates valuable visual material, renderings, drawings, progress photos, finished photography, job-site videos, and more.

We are looking for someone to take ownership of those digital assets and turn them into long-term value for the company.

This is not a traditional Social Media Manager position. It is a hands-on combination of digital asset management, creative content production, AI-powered visual creation, and digital marketing.



Mission of the Role:



You will own the lifecycle of our visual content, from raw material to organized assets to polished content that can be used for marketing, sales, our website, social media, and presentations.

A successful person in this role should constantly be thinking:

“What valuable content do we have, what are we missing, and how can I turn it into something useful?”



Key Responsibilities:



1. Digital Asset & Project Portfolio Management

• Take ownership of the company's growing library of photos, videos, renderings, drawings, graphics, and other visual assets.

• Gather assets coming from multiple sources, including project managers, installers, job sites, internal communication channels, renderings, phones, drone footage, and management.

• Develop and maintain an organized, scalable Digital Asset Management system.

• Recommend the best platforms, workflows, naming structures, folders, tagging systems, and processes for managing our assets.

• Make assets easy to search, retrieve, share, and reuse.

• Review incoming content and identify what is valuable, what needs improvement, and how it can be used.

• Maintain organized portfolios of completed and ongoing projects.

• Ensure valuable content does not get lost simply because nobody noticed or organized it.

2. Photo, Rendering & Visual Production

• Select and prepare the best images from projects.

• Retouch, crop, color-correct, clean up, enhance, and professionally present photographs.

• Improve job-site photos that were taken under less-than-ideal conditions.

• Work with architectural/design renderings and transform them into more realistic, polished marketing visuals when appropriate.

• Create new visuals using existing drawings, layouts, renderings, photos, and AI tools.

• Create before/after, progress, comparison, project showcase, and similar visual content.

• Handle day-to-day digital graphic design needs without requiring an outside graphic designer for every small task.

3. Video Content

We do not expect high-end film production. We do expect strong, practical digital video skills.

Responsibilities include:

• Gather raw video from job sites, phones, project managers, installers, and future drone footage.

• Identify the best clips and turn raw footage into useful content.

• Trim, combine, clean up, resize, and enhance video.

• Add captions, text, graphics, transitions, music, voiceovers, or other elements when appropriate.

• Remove or replace unwanted audio.

4. Directing Content Capture

5. Social Media & Digital Presence

Own the day-to-day execution of our digital presence, particularly:

• Instagram

• LinkedIn

• WhatsApp Status

• Google Business presence

• Company website

• 

• Other relevant platforms as they develop

Responsibilities include:

• Develop content from our existing project assets.

• Create and publish posts, reels, project showcases, and updates.

• Maintain a consistent posting schedule.

• Actively optimize content for maximum reach, traffic, engagement, and exposure on each platform. Understand how each platform’s algorithms, formats, timing, keywords, hashtags, trends, and other best practices affect visibility, and continuously test and improve our approach based on performance.

• Adapt content appropriately for different platforms rather than simply posting the exact same thing everywhere.

• Monitor and respond appropriately to comments, messages, and DMs.

• Keep the company's online presence active, polished, professional, and consistent with our established brand guidelines.

• Look for opportunities to repurpose existing material rather than constantly needing new content.

6. Website & Project Portfolio

• Keep the website visually current and up to date.

• Maintain the website’s project portfolio and visual content on an ongoing basis, ensuring it remains current, polished, accurate, and reflective of the company’s latest work.

• Upload completed projects with strong imagery and well-written descriptions.

• Organize projects so prospective customers can easily understand the work being presented.

• Maintain and improve the online portfolio as new work becomes available.

• Handle basic website content updates and minor technical/HTML-related work when needed.

• Coordinate with outside technical professionals when an update is beyond the scope of this position.

7.
 & Other Digital Marketing

When
 marketing campaigns are used:

• Prepare and organize the visual content.

• Build or assist with
 layouts.

• Insert images, links, buttons, and other digital assets correctly.

• Handle basic formatting/HTML as necessary.

• Coordinate with others when copywriting or more advanced technical work is required.

8. AI & Technology

Advanced practical use of AI is an important part of this position.

We want someone who actively explores how modern tools can make work faster, better, and possible.

This may include AI for:

• Image generation and enhancement

• Rendering enhancement and photorealistic visualization

• Photo editing and cleanup

• Video production and editing

• Voiceover/audio

• Graphic creation

• Content development

• Copy assistance

• Workflow automation

• Asset organization

• Research and productivity

We are not looking for someone who simply knows how to type prompts into ChatGPT. We want someone who is curious about new technology, experiments with tools, learns quickly, and continually improves the workflow.



Required Experience & Skills:



We are primarily interested in ability and portfolio, not degrees or job titles.

The ideal candidate will have:

• Approximately 2–5+ years of relevant hands-on experience in digital content, multimedia, creative production, digital marketing, or a related field.

• Strong creative judgment, the ability to independently recognize what looks professional, what content has marketing potential, and what needs improvement without requiring detailed direction for every task.

• Strong photo editing and enhancement abilities.

• Practical video editing experience.

• Good graphic design skills and a strong visual eye.

• Experience creating content specifically for social media.

• Understanding of social media platforms, formats, trends, and engagement.

• Experience working with AI-powered creative tools.

• Strong organizational and digital file-management skills.

• Ability to learn new platforms and software quickly.

• Basic website/content-management experience.

• Basic HTML knowledge is preferred.

• Excellent written English.

• Clear spoken English for internal meetings and communication.

• Strong attention to detail.

• Ability to work independently and take ownership.



Cultural & Brand Adaptability:



Our company serves customers with specific preferences, expectations, communication styles, and cultural nuances.

The successful candidate must be able to:

• Observe and quickly understand the culture and audience of the company.

• Learn subtle differences in communication, imagery, style, and presentation.

• Avoid assuming that what works for one audience automatically works for another.

• Follow established brand guidelines while developing a strong understanding of what feels appropriate for our customers.

• Accept feedback and quickly adapt.



Who Will Thrive in This Position:



You will likely do very well here if you are the type of person who:

• Sees an interesting job-site photo and immediately thinks, “We can do something with this.”

• Doesn't wait to be told every individual task.

• Enjoys both creativity and organization.

• Likes turning messy raw material into something polished.

• Notices missing information and goes after it.

• Enjoys experimenting with AI and new technology.

• Can research a problem and propose a solution.

• Can build a system instead of simply following one.

• Understands that creating great content and properly organizing it are equally important.

• Takes ownership and follows things through to completion.



Work Schedule:



This is a full-time remote position working on our standard Eastern Time schedule:

Monday–Thursday: 9:00 AM–6:00 PM Eastern Time

Friday: 9:00 AM–1:00 PM Eastern Time

Candidates must be consistently available for communication, collaboration, and meetings during these hours.



Equipment & Work Environment:



Because this is a remote creative position, the selected candidate must have:

• A modern, reliable computer powerful enough to smoothly handle professional photo editing, video editing, graphics, browser-based AI tools, and multitasking.

• 32 GB RAM minimum; 64 GB preferred.

• Modern Intel i7 / AMD Ryzen 7 / Apple Silicon equivalent or better preferred.

• Dedicated modern GPU with at least 8 GB of VRAM preferred, suitable for professional video editing, rendering, and AI workloads.

• 1 TB SSD storage.

• Reliable high-speed internet suitable for regularly uploading and downloading large photo and video files.

• Webcam and good-quality headset/microphone.

• A quiet, professional, designated workspace.

• A second monitor is strongly preferred.

The selected candidate is expected to provide and maintain the standard hardware, software, tools, and resources commonly required to perform this type of professional creative work.

Specialized, enterprise-level, unusually expensive, or company-specific tools may be provided by Space Art Cabinetry at the company's discretion.



Portfolio Required:



Applicants must submit examples of previous work.

We are particularly interested in seeing examples involving:

• Photo editing/enhancement

• Social media content

• Graphics

• Video editing

• Project or portfolio presentation

• AI-generated or AI-enhanced creative work

Please clearly explain what you personally did on each example.



Hiring Process:



Candidates who appear to be a strong fit will go through:

1. Initial application and portfolio review.

2. Video interview.

3. Practical skills test using sample materials similar to what you would receive in this position.

4. Final interview.

5. Paid introductory/trial period.

The practical test may include raw project photos, videos, renderings, and other assets. Candidates may be asked to demonstrate how they would organize the assets, improve them, turn them into useful content, and d
 how that content should be presented or distributed.



Compensation:



Hourly position.

Compensation will be determined based on experience, portfolio quality, technical ability, and performance during the practical skills evaluation.

Performance and compensation may be reviewed after the initial employment period.

________________________________________

The bottom line: We are looking for someone who can take ownership of our company's digital assets and digital presence, from a raw photo sitting in a job-site chat to a polished image, project portfolio, website update, reel, or social media post.

If you are highly organized, visually creative, technically capable, AI-driven, and naturally look for ways to turn raw material into valuable content, we would like to hear from you.

title: Video Editor for US Fitness Studio - Premiere Pro, Talking Head + Shorts (Part Time, Long Term)
description:
I run a small personal training studio in Los Angeles. I film myself talking to camera about fat loss, training, and why most diets fall apart. I am good at filming. I am slow at editing, and that is the only reason my videos are not getting published.



I want to hand that job to one person and stop thinking about it.



WHAT THE WORK IS



Every week I send you raw footage. You send me back finished video.



Per month:

- 4 long videos, 3 to 5 minutes each, me talking to camera

- 20 to 24 vertical clips cut from that same footage, for Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts

- B-roll cut into short labeled segments I can reuse



The look is already built. I will give you the template, the motion graphics files, the fonts, the colors, and written instruction sheets for every graphic. Your job is to apply it the same way every time. Not to redesign it.



WHAT I NEED YOU TO BE GOOD AT



- Adobe Premiere Pro. Organized projects, labeled bins, not 200 clips on one timeline.

- Cutting a talking-head video so it moves. Taking out the ums, the false starts, and the parts where I lose my train of thought, without it sounding chopped up.

- Reframing horizontal footage to vertical so my head is not cut off.

- Clean captions. Correct spelling, good timing, not covering my face.

- Basic color correction. Matching shots so my footage looks the same from cut to cut, and applying the preset I give you. I am not looking for a creative grade. I want it consistent.

- Audio cleanup. Even levels through the whole video, room noise down, nothing clipping. If a viewer has to reach for the volume knob, the edit failed.

- Hitting a deadline. And if you cannot hit it, telling me before it passes, not after.

- Writing to me in clear English. If a brief is unclear, ask me. Do not guess and hope.



WHAT THIS IS NOT



This is not a creative director job. I am not looking for someone to reinvent the style every month. I want someone reliable who makes the same good thing over and over and gets faster at it. If you want full creative freedom, this will frustrate you.



THE ARRANGEMENT



Part time, ongoing, paid monthly. Same amount every month for the volume above. Rate depends on your experience and how the test goes.



I would rather hire one person and train them well than keep starting over with new editors. If you are looking for a few weeks of work, this is not it.



HOW TO APPLY



Put the word ORANGE at the top of your message so I know you read this.



Then send me:



1. Two links to talking-head videos you edited. For each one, tell me exactly what you did. If you only did the captions, say so. I will trust you more, not less.

2. What version of Premiere you use, and what computer you edit on.

3. A screenshot of your internet speed test.

4. Your available hours per week, and your time zone.

5. One sentence: what makes a talking-head video boring?



Applications without the word ORANGE will not be read.



Shortlisted applicants get a small paid test edit. I pay for the test whether I hire you or not.

title: Remote Marketing & CRM Operations
description:
Are you a detail-oriented, tech-savvy Virtual Professional who enjoys working behind the scenes to keep systems clean, connected, and reliable?



We’re looking for a proactive VP of Backend Operations & CRM Systems to support a high-performing service business by maintaining accurate data flow across HubSpot, CallRail, RingCentral, Arrivy, Vendo, and Webflow. This role is ideal for someone who is organized, systems-minded, comfortable troubleshooting platform issues, and able to help leadership pull accurate reports on leads, appointments, and revenue by source.



This is not a strategy role. The focus is on backend operations, data accuracy, CRM cleanup, reporting support, and workflow efficiency.



What You’ll Do



You’ll support day-to-day backend operations by helping ensure the client’s tools are properly set up, connected, and producing clean, reliable data.



CRM, Reporting & Data Management

• Review and clean up HubSpot data to ensure leads, appointments, deals, and revenue are accurately tracked.

• Help build and maintain HubSpot reports that leadership can easily pull and trust.

• Check that data from CallRail, web forms, Vendo, and Arrivy maps correctly into HubSpot.

• Identify missing, duplicate, or inconsistent lead source data and help correct it.

• Maintain clean deal records, contact records, and source attribution where needed.



CallRail, RingCentral & Source Attribution Support

• Review CallRail tracking numbers and confirm they are assigned to the correct lead sources, such as Google Ads, LSA, organic, referral, or outbound campaigns.

• Help clean up source attribution issues where outbound calls are incorrectly tagged under sales reps rather than the proper source categories.

• Support workflow improvements between CallRail and RingCentral to reduce platform-switching friction for the call center team.

• Document issues, patterns, and recommended fixes clearly.



Platform & Workflow Support

• Review the flow of information from HubSpot to Arrivy, Vendo, and back to HubSpot.

• Help troubleshoot minor system issues and coordinate with platform support teams when needed.

• Assist with routine Webflow content updates and minor website maintenance.

• Clearly document processes, updates, and recurring tasks so the team has reliable SOPs.



Admin & Communication Support

• Communicate clearly with the client, team members, and vendor/platform support teams.

• Provide regular updates on progress, blockers, and completed tasks.

• Use AI tools responsibly to improve documentation, reporting, and written communication.

• Maintain organized records, task lists, and process guides.

- Hours worked

- Activity levels

- Work sessions

- Screenshots or periodic activity snapshots, depending on the software settings

# Expert eCommerce Direct-Response Video Editor — Meta Ads

**Remote | Full-Time or Contract**



We are a rapidly scaling eCommerce brand seeking an expert-level **Direct-Response Video Editor** to create high-converting Meta ad creatives. This role is specifically for editors who specialize in **eCommerce VSLs and paid social advertising**. If direct-response eCommerce editing is not a core part of your daily work, this position will not be the right fit.



Your primary responsibility will be editing **3–5 minute VSL-style Meta ads**.

You will also create short-form ad formats, including: Claymation-style creatives, Pixar-style creatives, and Other emerging direct-response formats



You must understand how to visually reinforce every line of a script and maintain viewer attention throughout the entire advertisement. Problem-focused sections should feel emotional, tense, frustrating, and relatable. Benefit-focused sections should feel aspirational, positive, hopeful, and transformational. You will be expected to create and incorporate AI-generated assets using tools such as Higgsfield, Magnific, and Heygen. Strong prompting skills and the ability to generate consistent, realistic assets are required.



For VSL content, the expected output is: One 3–5 minute VSL per day which includes One main body & Five hook variations

You must be able to meet daily deadlines and maintain consistent communication.



To be considered, you must submit:



*eCommerce VSLs that you personally edited

* Your typical turnaround time for a 3-5 minute VSL

* Your availability for an interview in Eastern Time



Applications without relevant eCommerce direct-response examples will not be considered.

At the very bottom of your application, include the word: apple

title: Certified GoHighLevel (GHL) & AI Automation Specialist (Home Services / HVAC / Plumbing)
description:
Certified GoHighLevel (GHL) & AI Automation Specialist (Home Services / HVAC / Plumbing)



Location: Remote



Job Type: Full-Time / Contract



About the Role

We are seeking an experienced, Certified GoHighLevel (GHL) Expert with a deep understanding of AI-driven lead automation and conversational phone AI. If you have hands-on experience building conversion-focused funnels and automated communication ecosystems for home service businesses (HVAC, Plumbing, Electrical, etc.), we want to talk to you.



You will be responsible for building, optimizing, and maintaining our complete CRM pipeline, multi-channel lead nurtures, AI voice/SMS conversational bots, and revenue-driving campaign engines.



Key Responsibilities

GHL Architecture & Optimization: Design, build, and manage complex GoHighLevel workflows, pipelines, snapshots, calendars, and custom fields tailored for home service operations.



AI & Voice AI Integration: Set up, train, and maintain AI conversational engines (e.g., Bland AI, Vapi, Retell, Air AI, or native GHL AI) for inbound lead response, after-hours booking, and outbound re-engagement calls.



Multi-Channel Lead Nurturing: Create high-converting SMS, MMS, and
 automation campaigns designed to re-engage past leads, confirm service appointments, and follow up on quotes.



Database Reactivation: Launch targeted text/email reactivation campaigns to convert old leads and existing customer databases into booked service calls.



System Integrations: Connect GHL with field service software (ServiceTitan, Housecall Pro, Jobber, etc.) via Zapier, Make, or native APIs to ensure seamless dispatching and lead flow.



Performance Tracking: Monitor deliverability, campaign response rates, call conversion rates, and ROI to continuously iterate and improve messaging.



Required Qualifications

Certification: Official GoHighLevel (GHL) Certification (or proven expert-level proficiency).



AI Expertise: Demonstrated experience setting up AI webchat, SMS AI bots, and conversational Phone/Voice AI calling agents.



Home Services Background: Direct experience working with HVAC, plumbing, electrical, or home service companies (understanding service seasonality, emergency dispatching, and homeowner buyer behavior).



Campaign & Content Mastery: Strong copywriting skills for high-converting SMS/email scripts, appointment reminders, and quote follow-ups.



Technical Savvy: Expert knowledge of webhooks, API integrations (Zapier/Make), domain/A2P 10DLC compliance, and DNS setups.



Bonus Points If You Have

Experience integrating GHL with ServiceTitan or Housecall Pro.



Understanding of paid local ads (Google Local Services Ads,
 Ads) and how they route into GHL.



Basic HTML/CSS knowledge for custom funnel styling inside GHL.



How to Apply

Please submit your resume along with:



Proof or mention of your GHL certification.



A brief summary of your past experience with home service businesses (HVAC/Plumbing).



1–2 examples of AI voice or SMS automations you have built.

title: Performance Marketing Specialist
description:
Performance Marketing Specialist

Remote | Part-Time (Growth Opportunity) | Grace Group

About Grace Group

Grace Group is a growing marketing agency that partners with small businesses and Direct Primary Care (DPC) practices across the United States. We believe marketing should do more than create visibility—it should generate measurable business growth.

Our team focuses on helping businesses attract more leads, strengthen their online presence, and clearly understand the return on their marketing investment.

We're looking for someone who enjoys both the strategic and technical sides of digital marketing and is excited to help build the next phase of our agency.

Position Overview

We're seeking a Performance Marketing Specialist to join our remote team on a part-time basis, with the opportunity for additional hours as our client base continues to grow.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working with Google Ads, analytics, website optimization, and digital marketing systems. You'll play an important role in helping our clients generate measurable results while ensuring their marketing efforts are accurately tracked and reported.

If you're someone who enjoys asking questions like...

• Why aren't conversions tracking?

• How can we lower cost per lead?

• Which marketing efforts are actually producing results?

• How can we improve this landing page?

• How do we better demonstrate ROI to our clients?

Performance Marketing

• Build, launch, and manage Google Ads campaigns

• Optimize Search, Display, Performance Max, and Local campaigns

• Assist with Meta advertising campaigns

• Conduct keyword research and competitor analysis

• Optimize campaigns to improve lead quality and ROI

• Create and improve landing pages for advertising campaigns

Analytics & Tracking

• Configure and maintain Google Analytics 4 (GA4)

• Build and manage Google Tag Manager (GTM)

• Set up and troubleshoot conversion tracking

• Configure Meta Pixel and Conversion API when appropriate

• Monitor Google Search Console

• Build easy-to-understand reporting dashboards

• Help clients clearly understand the performance of their marketing investment

Website Support

You'll help build and maintain client websites using platforms such as:

• Wix

• Squarespace

• GoDaddy Websites + Marketing

• WordPress (when needed)

Responsibilities include:

• Building new pages

• Landing page creation

• Website updates

• Mobile optimization

• Basic SEO implementation

• Website launches

• Troubleshooting website issues

Programming experience is a plus but not required. Most of our work is completed using modern website builders rather than custom development.

Search Engine Optimization

• On-page SEO implementation

• Metadata optimization

• Google Business Profile recommendations

• Technical SEO audits

• Search Console monitoring

• Website performance improvements

Client Support

• Help explain marketing reports in a way clients understand

• Participate in strategy discussions when needed

• Recommend opportunities for improving campaign performance

• Work closely with the Grace Group team to deliver exceptional client experiences

Qualifications

• Google Ads

• Google Analytics 4 (GA4)

• Google Tag Manager

• Google Search Console

• Meta Ads Manager

• Meta Pixel

• Website builders (Wix, Squarespace, GoDaddy, WordPress)

• Landing page creation

• Basic SEO best practices

• Strong analytical thinking

• Excellent written and spoken English

• Strong organizational skills

• Ability to manage multiple client projects

Bonus Skills

• Looker Studio

• Elementor

• Basic HTML/CSS

• Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO)

• Healthcare marketing

• Local SEO

• AI tools that improve productivity and marketing performance

What Success Looks Like (First 90 Days)

• Successfully manage client advertising campaigns

• Ensure accurate conversion tracking across client accounts

• Support website updates and landing page development

• Deliver meaningful performance insights to our team

• Help improve the ROI of client marketing campaigns

• Become a trusted technical resource within Grace Group

Why Join Grace Group?

We're a collaborative, relationship-focused agency that values curiosity, ownership, and continuous learning.



This position begins as part-time, but we're growing quickly and anticipate opportunities for increased hours and long-term growth as our client base expands.



If you're excited about helping businesses grow while growing your own career alongside us, we'd love to hear from you.

How to Apply

Please submit:

• Resume

• Cover Letter

• Portfolio or examples of digital marketing work

• Google Ads or Analytics certifications (if applicable)

• Examples of websites you've built or managed

As part of your application, please answer the following questions:

1. Tell us about a Google Ads campaign you've personally managed. What was the objective, and what results did you achieve?

2. A client notices Google Ads reports more conversions than GA4. What are a few reasons this might happen?

3. Which website platforms have you worked with? Please describe your level of experience with each.

4. Have you worked with Google Tag Manager? If so, describe a project where you set up or troubleshot conversion tracking.

5. Have you built reporting dashboards? If yes, which tools have you used?

6. What AI tools or technologies do you regularly use to improve your work?

7. Why are you interested in joining Grace Group, and what excites you about helping our clients grow?

title: SENIOR Creative Strategist
description:
We are looking for a Senior Creative Strategist to help us build and scale our frontend creative engine toward 7-figure revenue.



This is NOT a junior role and it is not a role where we want to teach someone the fundamentals from scratch.



We’re looking for someone who has already done this at a high level: someone who has built, tested and scaled direct-response creative for serious DTC/e-commerce brands and can bring proven systems, experience and proven ideas from day one.



Ideally, you’ve worked with supplements, health/wellness, MRR or subscription brands, but strong DTC experience with demonstrable results is more important than the exact niche.



What you’ll own:

You’ll be responsible for helping us develop a repeatable creative system that can support increasingly aggressive Meta Ads spend.



That means you should be comfortable going far beyond simply writing creative briefs.



You should be able to:

-Find new scalable angles for a core product.

-Develop different mechanisms, avatars and narratives around the same product.

-Create aggressive, compelling direct-response hooks without relying on recycled concepts.

-Develop concepts across VSLs, LFS, statics, UGC, advertorial-style creative and other direct-response formats.

-Understand offers and direct-response copywriting deeply enough to know how they interact with creative.

-Analyse creative performance and determine why something won or lost.

-Use performance data to d
 what should be tested next.

-Take winning concepts and systematically iterate them rather than producing random variations.

-Build a structured creative testing and iteration system.

-Turn customer/market research into actionable creative angles and concepts.

-Help improve the entire creative process as Meta spend scales.

-Ultimately, we want someone who can help us build a creative engine, not someone who simply produces a list of ideas.



Non-negotiable requirements:



-Proven experience as a SENIOR Creative Strategist for DTC/e-commerce brands.

-Strong, hands-on experience with Meta Ads and direct-response creative.

-A track record of working with meaningful advertising budgets.

-Experience personally developing creative that has generated significant spend and results.

-Strong understanding of angles, avatars, hooks, mechanisms, narratives and offers.

-Experience with multiple creative formats, including VSL/LFS, UGC, static and advertorial-style creative.

-The ability to analyse performance data and turn insights into the next round of creative tests.

-A proper creative research, testing and iteration process.

-Strong communication and strategic thinking.

-Experience with supplements, health/wellness or subscription/MRR businesses is a major plus.



Please DO NOT send long application/cover letter. Be straight to the point and send your LINK for the Proof supporting your experience as a SENIOR Creative Strategist. 



We will be very strict about evidence and personal contribution. If you’ve genuinely built and scaled creative for serious DTC brands, we want to hear from you.

title: Amazon / Bol.com Listing & Catalog VA
description:
Happy on Web is a Dutch e-commerce company selling consumer electronics accessories (e-bike batteries and chargers, audio, adapters, smart home) on 
, Amazon, eBay, Kaufland and French marketplaces. 1,400+ products, growing fast.



## The job



Every marketplace has its own rules for product pages: which images are allowed, which fields are required, how categories, EANs and product data must be filled, which words and claims are not allowed. The rules change, and we add new products every week. Your job is to make sure every product we sell meets those rules — now, and every time something changes.



Concretely:



- You work through our full catalog product by product, using a written checklist we give you, and record per product what you checked and what you found.

- You check images (logos, certification marks, packaging claims, image requirements), category and product type, EAN/GS1 data, required fields (product safety data, manufacturer information), and listing text.

- Our listing text is in Dutch, German and French. You run it through a translation tool and screen it against a list of flag words and patterns we give you. If anything matches, you flag it and paste the original sentence.

- Where the checklist tells you what the correct value is (wrong or missing fields, category, EAN data, image requirements), you fix it yourself — and you log every change in a before/after column in Google Sheets, so every edit you make can be traced and checked.

- Text is different. You don't rewrite titles, descriptions or specifications in Dutch, German or French. If text violates a rule, you flag it with the original sentence, and a colleague who reads the language d
 and writes the fix. You never guess what a product spec should be.

- You do notice patterns. If the same field is missing on forty products in a row, if a flag word catches everything, if the checklist doesn't cover something you keep running into: you write it down and send it to us as a suggestion. Separately from your tracker, and without changing how you work until we say so.

- Once the full catalog is done, the work continues: new products before they go live, re-checks when a marketplace changes its rules, and later the same for our other marketplaces.

- Second phase, once the audit routine runs: you also handle the follow-up with the marketplaces. That means opening seller support cases (rejected images, EAN conflicts, wrong category, blocked or suppressed listings, policy questions) using our templates, tracking them, and answering the marketplace's replies. This is seller-side case work with 
 and Amazon, not buyer-facing customer service.



Output: one tracker row per product. Every row has a source (screenshot, field name, URL, exact sentence). "None" or "looks fine" is not a valid entry. If you checked something and found nothing, you write down what you checked.



This is repetitive, precise work at around 40 products per day. If you get bored by checklists, this is not your job. If you like a list that gets shorter every day and a tracker that is always correct, it is.



## What we need from you



- Experience working in a marketplace seller back-end (Amazon Seller Central, 
, eBay or similar) on the product data side: listings, catalog, product fields. Not customer service, not ads.

- Spreadsheet discipline: you can work through thousands of rows without skipping one, and your tracker is readable by someone who has never seen it.

- You follow a checklist exactly. When the checklist doesn't cover a case, you don't guess: you flag it and ask.

- You think while you work. You see when the same problem keeps coming back, and you tell us what you think is behind it. We want those suggestions; we don't want you acting on them on your own.

- You can work with text in a language you don't read using translation tools, and you say so when a translation is not good enough to judge.

- Clear written English. We work asynchronously; almost all communication is written.



Not needed: Dutch, design skills, PPC, 
 experience specifically.



## Who this job is not for



Please don't apply if you are mainly a:



- Graphic designer or product image designer. There is no design in this job.

- PPC / Amazon Ads specialist. We don't run ads in-house.

- Amazon growth, brand or marketplace manager. Nobody manages anything here; you check products against a list.

- General VA (admin,
, social media, appointment setting). We select on marketplace product data experience, not on being flexible.

- Buyer-facing customer service (answering customers, returns, chat support). Note the difference: seller support cases with 
 or Amazon about listing and policy issues are part of this job, and experience with those is a plus. Answering buyers is not.



If your profile is a mix of many of the above, you will not be selected. We want someone who has done product data work in a marketplace back-end and likes doing it precisely.



## What we select on



Only these four things, in this order:



1. Hands-on experience in a marketplace seller back-end on the product data side (listings, catalog, product fields). Show it with specifics, not with a tool list.

2. Proof that you can do large repetitive data work accurately (your answer to point 2 below).

3. Written English: clear, short, answers the question asked.

4. Whether you followed the application instructions exactly.



We select on depth, not on numbers: one platform where you really did the product data work beats five platforms you touched. Years on a resume, certificates and tool lists don't tell us that — your specifics do.



A plus, not a requirement: you have opened and followed up seller support cases with Amazon or 
 about listing or policy issues (suppressed listings, image rejections, EAN or category problems). If you have, tell us in point 4 below.



To show us you have read this far: put the word ROSENBERGER in the subject line of your application.



## What we offer



- $650/month, full-time (40 hours), fixed monthly rate paid via Wise

- Long-term position, normal contract, no trial-project construction

- Start date: Monday 14 September 2026

- Software and tools paid by us

- Written SOPs and a checklist. You are not expected to know the rules by heart; you are expected to apply the checklist exactly and to tell us when it doesn't cover a case.



## How to apply



Send us:



1. Which marketplace back-ends you have worked in, how long, and what you did in them.

2. One example of a large repetitive data-checking job you did (any kind): how many items, how you kept it accurate, how you tracked your progress — and one thing you noticed while doing it that you passed on to whoever you worked for.

3. Your availability from the start date above.

4. Optional: one seller support case you opened yourself with Amazon or 
 about a listing or policy issue. What the issue was, what you wrote, what the outcome was. Skip this point if you haven't done it; don't invent one.



Keep it short and specific. Don't claim accuracy — show it in your answer to point 2.



Applications that don't answer points 1 to 3 will not be read.



Selection: short
 exchange, then a video call.
