title: AI Agent Engineer | Build & Run the Agent Stack for a TikTok Shop Agency
description:
Read this entire post before applying. Your first line tells me whether you did.



WHO WE ARE



We run a full-service TikTok Shop marketplace management agency — affiliate program management, GMV Max ads, violation resolution, and conversion optimization for US brands. Demand is outpacing us, so we are not hiring our way out of it. We are building an agentic agency: AI agents run the machine, humans provide the judgment, taste, and relationships on top.



Every stage of the client lifecycle — proposal, onboarding, creator sourcing and outreach, reporting, QA, escalation, renewal — is being rebuilt as an agent workflow with a human owner reviewing the output, not a human doing the clicking.



I need the person who builds that machine and then runs it.



WHAT YOU OWN



BUILD — Design, build, and ship the agents and bots that run the business. Multi-agent workflows, tool use, API integrations, retrieval over our SOPs and client data, and evals so we know when an agent is wrong. Claude, GPT, Grok/xAI, n8n / Make / Zapier, and Python where it earns its place.



RUN — Own it in production. Monitoring, error handling, cost control, prompt and output iteration. When something breaks on a client account, you know before the client does.



DELIVER — Use the stack to actually manage client accounts alongside our human team. You will be inside real accounts and, when it matters, on client calls explaining what the system is doing and why the results beat their last agency.



TEACH — Document SOPs and train our VAs and account managers to operate the agent stack confidently. Your job is to multiply the team, not to become its bottleneck.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE IN 90 DAYS



- A signed proposal becomes a fully onboarded client with a fraction of the human hours it takes today

- Weekly client reporting is generated, QA'd, and delivered by agents with a human sign-off

- Our account managers carry several times the client load they can today, with better results

- We can prove with numbers that we outperform traditional agencies



YOU ARE A FIT IF



- You have shipped agent systems other people depend on daily — not demos, not tutorials

- You are fluent across model providers and have real opinions about which model belongs where, including Grok/xAI

- APIs, webhooks, auth, and silent failures do not scare you

- You think in systems and write clean documentation without being asked

- Your written and spoken English is strong enough for client-facing copy and solo client calls

- You ship, measure, iterate, and tell me directly when something is not working



YOU ARE NOT A FIT IF



- Your AI experience is prompting ChatGPT for captions

- You need a fully specified ticket before you can start

- You go quiet for days and resurface with excuses



THE DETAILS



- Full time, 40 hours per week, long-term

- Pay: open. There is no ceiling for the right person — tell me your number and why you are worth it

- 2–3 hours of daily overlap with US Central Time

- Immediate start

- Clear path to Head of Automation as we scale



HOW TO APPLY



Applications that skip these steps get deleted. No exceptions.



1) Open your message with: AGENTS > HEADCOUNT



2) Answer these briefly and specifically:

   a. What agent system have you built that people used every single day? What did it do?

   b. What was the hardest failure mode you ran into, and how did you fix it?

   c. Which model do you reach for by default, and where specifically do you use Grok/xAI?

   d. What do you build on — n8n, LangGraph, Make, custom Python, something else?

   e. How do you catch a wrong agent output before a client sees it?

   f. If I asked you to automate client onboarding for a TikTok Shop agency, what would you build first?

   g. Your monthly rate and your earliest start date.



3) Send proof — links, repos, screen recordings, dashboards. Anything that shows you built what you say you built.



Send a 3–5 minute Loom walking me through one thing you have built and you go straight to the top of my list.



Finalists complete a short paid build task. If you are the right person, this will be the easiest hire I ever make.

title: Project Manager – Publications & Creative Projects
description:
Full-Time | Remote | Philippines



Spiritus is an international Catholic sacred-music organization bringing together music, art, faith, ecology, and cultural heritage. Our projects involve musicians, artists, writers, churches, cathedrals, schools, cultural institutions, and environmental organizations around the world.



Spiritus is entering a major period of growth, with new performances, recordings, publications, international collaborations, and ecological initiatives now in development.



We are looking for an exceptionally organized and detail-oriented Project Manager – Publications & Creative Projects to join our team in the Philippines.



This is an unusual role combining project management, editorial and publication work, document preparation, research, recruitment, and creative production.



It would be particularly well suited to someone with experience in publishing, editorial design, graphic design, communications, document production, or creative project management who is ready to take on broader responsibility.



The right person will have the opportunity to gradually take ownership of major Spiritus projects and grow into a larger leadership role within the organization.



What You’ll Work On



One of your first major projects will be helping manage the production of a beautiful approximately 200-page commemorative art book documenting a sacred-music recording project in France.



The book will combine extensive photography, essays and spiritual reflections, musical analysis, texts and translations, captions, credits, and other materials. We intend it to have the quality and visual sophistication of a book published by a major museum, gallery, or cultural institution.



You will help manage the assembly of the book from beginning to end, including:



Organizing hundreds of photographs and other visual assets

Collecting and tracking essays, texts, translations, captions, credits, and other materials

Coordinating with writers, editors, designers, translators, photographers, and other contributors

Preparing, formatting, and proofreading documents

Maintaining detailed records of what has been received, what is missing, what requires revision, and what still needs approval

Working closely with the book designer to make sure every element is complete and correct

Helping manage revisions and final preparation for publication

Maintaining organized project files, trackers, and documentation



You do not need to be a professional book designer. We expect to hire a specialist designer for the major art book. Your role will be to help organize and manage the large amount of material that goes into the publication, work closely with the designer, and make sure nothing falls through the cracks.



Other Spiritus Projects



You will also assist with a wide range of other Spiritus projects, including:



Preparing materials for CDs and CD booklets and coordinating with manufacturers

Organizing text, photography, credits, metadata, and other publication materials

Creating and editing polished documents and presentation materials

Helping manage an international project collecting nature photography, video, and sound recordings

Overseeing and guiding ongoing searches for project submissions

Conducting detailed online research and outreach

Researching cultural institutions, publications, universities, organizations, and potential collaborators

Running recruitment searches for specialized creative professionals

Managing job postings and applicant pipelines

Screening applicants and reviewing resumes and portfolios

Researching promising candidates and preparing strong shortlists

Helping coordinate other Spiritus projects as the organization continues to grow



As you gain experience with Spiritus, you may gradually take greater ownership of projects, coordinate other team members, and independently manage larger areas of work.



Who We’re Looking For



Above all, we need someone who is extremely organized, meticulous, resourceful, reliable, and capable of taking ownership.



Strong candidates may come from backgrounds such as:



Publishing or editorial production

Book, magazine, or publication design

Graphic or document design

Communications

Creative project management

Arts or cultural organizations

Media production

Editorial operations



You should have:



Exceptional attention to detail

Excellent written English

Strong organizational and project-management ability

Good visual judgment and typography/layout instincts

Experience preparing sophisticated documents or publications

Strong skills with Adobe InDesign and/or other professional design and document-production software

Strong proofreading and editorial skills

The ability to organize large quantities of text, images, files, and information

Strong research skills and confidence finding people and information online

The ability to manage many small details without losing sight of the larger project

The ability to communicate clearly with writers, designers, vendors, applicants, and other collaborators

Strong follow-through and reliability

The initiative to identify and solve problems independently rather than simply waiting for instructions



Experience with books, publications, museums, cultural institutions, music, photography, visual arts, or international creative projects is especially welcome.



The Kind of Person Who Will Succeed Here



You are probably a good fit if you are the person who notices when:



A caption or credit is missing

A filename is inconsistent

A photograph has not yet been approved

A contributor still owes us a document

Two versions of a file are being confused

Something in a layout does not look right

A deadline is approaching and someone needs to follow up

A project would work better if there were a clearer system behind it



You should enjoy bringing order to complex creative projects and taking something with hundreds of moving pieces and helping turn it into a beautiful, finished result.



About Spiritus



Spiritus creates ambitious sacred-music and cultural projects with an international scope.



Our work brings together music, Catholic faith, beauty, ecology, culture, and the natural world, often in collaboration with churches, cathedrals, musicians, artists, scholars, educators, cultural organizations, and environmental groups.



Current projects involve participants and collaborators across the United States, Europe, Africa, Asia, and elsewhere.



We are a small and growing organization, so this is not a narrowly defined corporate position. The right person will have the opportunity to become deeply involved in our projects, take increasing responsibility, and grow with the organization.



Learn more about our work at Spiritus.art.



Location: Philippines, remote

Schedule: Full-time

Reports to: Spiritus Philippines Manager



To Apply



Please send:



Your resume/CV

A short introduction explaining why this particular position interests you

Examples of publications, books, documents, layouts, presentations, or other visual/editorial work you have produced or helped manage

A brief description of the most complicated project you have personally organized or coordinated

A short explanation of how you kept that project organized and made sure important details were not missed



We care much more about quality, judgment, organization, initiative, and attention to detail than about having a particular degree or job title.

About Us



We are a U.S.-based chiropractic and wellness clinic looking for an experienced Google Ads Specialist to take ownership of our Google Ads account, with a particular focus on Performance Max and local lead generation.

Your Responsibilities



You will be responsible for:



- Managing and optimizing our Google Ads account

- Building, managing, and optimizing Performance Max campaigns

- Managing Google Search campaigns

- Keyword research and search-term analysis

- Building and maintaining negative keyword lists

- Monitoring CPC, CTR, conversion rate, cost per lead, cost per booked appointment, and ROAS

- Improving targeting and lead quality

- Reviewing geographic/location targeting

- Testing ad copy, headlines, offers, audiences, and campaign structure

- Managing bidding strategies and budgets

- Working with GA4 and Google Tag Manager

- Reviewing landing-page performance and recommending improvements

- Providing a concise weekly performance report

- Clearly explaining what was changed, why it was changed, and what happened as a result



What Matters to Us



We care about actual business results, not vanity metrics.



A cheap lead is not valuable if the lead never schedules.



Our primary KPIs will include:



Ad Spend → Leads → Cost Per Lead → Calls/Contacts → Booked New Patients → Show Rate → Conversion → Revenue/ROAS



You should be comfortable looking beyond Google Ads metrics and helping us determine whether campaigns are producing actual qualified patients.



Requirements



You should have:



- At least 2+ years of hands-on Google Ads experience

- Strong experience with Performance Max

- Experience generating leads for local/service businesses

- Strong understanding of Search campaigns

- GA4 and Google Tag Manager experience

- Conversion-tracking experience

- Strong analytical skills

- Excellent attention to detail

- Ability to work independently

- Good written English

- Experience optimizing campaigns with relatively small/local-business advertising budgets



Healthcare, chiropractic, medical, dental, med-spa, or other local healthcare lead-generation experience is a major plus.



Schedule



Approximately 2 hours per day, Monday through Friday (10 hours/week).



This is an ongoing role. We are looking for someone who will consistently monitor and improve the account rather than simply set up campaigns and leave them running.



There may be an opportunity for additional hours/responsibilities as performance improves.



How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. How many years have you personally managed Google Ads?

2. Describe your experience with Performance Max.

3. Have you managed Google Ads for a healthcare or local service business? Please describe.

4. What monthly Google Ads budgets have you managed?

8. What is your expected hourly rate?

9. Please provide screenshots or examples of campaign results you personally managed. You may remove or blur client-identifying information.

 attachments, no personal storage)

- Trustworthy handling of sensitive financial documents - must sign an NDA / data-handling agreement before starting

*Nice to Have*

- Prior experience in financial services, lending, or loan processing support

title: Administrative Assistant – Operations Support
description:
About the Company

We are a growing U.S.-based company seeking an experienced, highly organized, and dependable Administrative Assistant – Operations Support to join our team on a long-term basis.



This position will play an important role in supporting our day-to-day operations and ensuring that administrative processes, customer communication, documentation, scheduling, and follow-up activities are handled accurately and efficiently.



We are looking for a professional, proactive, detail-oriented individual who takes ownership of responsibilities, communicates effectively, and can manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.



Position Responsibilities

Provide comprehensive administrative and operational support to management and internal teams.

Manage daily administrative tasks, priorities, deadlines, and follow-ups.

Monitor outstanding tasks and ensure timely completion.

Handle inbound calls and customer communications professionally when required.

Schedule appointments, meetings, inspections, and other business activities.

Maintain accurate and up-to-date customer, project, and operational records.

Enter, organize, and update information within CRM systems, spreadsheets, and other company platforms.

Maintain organized digital files, documents, reports, and administrative records.

Conduct online research and prepare clear, organized summaries for management.

Coordinate information between customers, team members, vendors, and other relevant parties.

Follow up proactively on outstanding requests, documents, appointments, and action items.

Assist in creating and maintaining SOPs, checklists, workflows, and internal documentation.

Identify administrative inefficiencies and recommend practical improvements.

Assist with process development and implementation as the company continues to grow.

Support special projects and other operational initiatives as assigned.

Maintain confidentiality and handle company and customer information responsibly.

Qualifications

Previous professional experience in Administrative Support, Operations, Virtual Assistance, Executive Assistance, or a related position.

Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

Exceptional organizational and time-management abilities.

Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.

Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.

Strong follow-up and task-management skills.

Professional telephone and customer communication skills.

Proficiency with Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, spreadsheets,
, and web-based applications.

Experience with CRM systems and project-management platforms is preferred.

Strong research, analytical, and problem-solving abilities.

Ability to learn new software, systems, and processes quickly.

Ability to work independently while maintaining consistent communication with management.

Reliable, accountable, and committed to meeting deadlines.

What We Are Looking For

The ideal candidate is more than someone who simply completes assigned tasks.



We are looking for a professional who can take ownership of responsibilities, anticipate what needs to be done, and maintain organization across multiple areas of the business.



You should be comfortable receiving priorities, developing a plan, executing tasks, and providing clear updates on progress.



Attention to detail is critical. We need someone who reviews their work, identifies potential issues before they become problems, and follows through until each responsibility is fully completed.



We also value continuous improvement. If you identify a better way to organize a process, reduce repetitive work, or improve communication, we want you to bring that idea forward.



Long-Term Growth Opportunity

This is a long-term position with opportunities for increased responsibility as the company expands.



Over time, the successful candidate may become involved in:



Operations coordination

CRM administration

Project coordination

Process improvement

SOP and workflow development

Customer experience

Team coordination

AI tools and business automation

Our goal is to find someone who wants to build a career with the company, not simply complete short-term assignments.



Application Instructions

Please include the following in your application:



Resume or detailed work history.

Brief professional introduction.

Previous experience in administrative or operations support.

Software and platforms you have experience using.

Experience managing multiple priorities and deadlines.

Availability and preferred working hours.

Expected hourly rate.

Application Question

Describe a situation where you were responsible for managing several competing priorities at the same time. How did you organize the work, determine what needed to be completed first, and ensure that nothing was overlooked?



Please provide a specific example.

title: Inbound Sales Representative, Phone Sales & Closing
description:
**Full Time Remote Position | U.S. Hours**



We are a growing residential cleaning company in Pennsylvania, USA, looking for an experienced **Sales Representative** to join our remote team.



**This is a SALES position. This is NOT a customer service position and NOT simply an appointment setting position.**



Your primary responsibility will be to speak with prospective customers who are interested in our cleaning services, understand what they need, provide estimates, overcome objections, follow up with leads, and **close sales**.



You will be expected to confidently ask customers to book and will be measured on your sales performance.



## What You Will Do



• Respond quickly to new inbound leads

• Call prospective customers who request information or an estimate

• Conduct sales and estimate calls with potential customers

• Ask questions to understand the customer's home, cleaning needs, priorities, and concerns

• Recommend the appropriate cleaning service

• Explain our services and pricing clearly and confidently

• Build trust and rapport with potential customers

• Handle common sales objections, including price, timing, comparing companies, and needing to speak with a spouse

• Ask for the sale and confidently move customers toward booking

• Follow up consistently with leads who do not book immediately

• Reconnect with older leads and opportunities

• Sell recurring cleaning services 

• Maintain accurate notes and lead statuses in our CRM

• Complete required daily sales tracking and reporting

• Meet individual sales and revenue goals



## This Position Is NOT



• A customer service only position

• A virtual assistant position with occasional sales tasks

• An appointment setting only position

• A position where you simply answer questions and send prices

• A scripted call center role where you read from a script and move to the next call



We need someone who can **have a real conversation, identify what matters to the customer, handle hesitation, and CLOSE.**



## Who We Are Looking For



You may be a great fit if you:



• Have previous phone sales experience

• Have experience speaking with U.S. customers

• Have personally been responsible for closing sales

• Are comfortable discussing pricing and asking for the sale

• Know how to handle objections without becoming pushy

• Are warm, confident, personable, and easy to understand over the phone

• Listen carefully and ask good follow up questions

• Can build rapport naturally rather than sounding scripted

• Are persistent with follow up

• Are comfortable being measured on sales results and KPIs

• Are organized and able to manage multiple leads at different stages

• Take ownership of your responsibilities without needing constant reminders

• Are reliable and communicate when you need help



**Previous customer service experience alone is not enough for this position. We are specifically looking for someone with sales and closing ability.**



Experience selling services to U.S. consumers is strongly preferred.



Schedule



This is a full time remote position.



Monday through Friday

9:00 AM to 6:00 PM Eastern Time

One hour lunch break



You must be able to consistently work U.S. Eastern Time hours.



## Requirements



• Excellent spoken and written English

• Strong, clear, professional phone presence

• Previous sales experience

• Reliable high speed internet

• Reliable computer and headset

• Quiet and professional workspace

• Comfortable using CRM and communication software

• Ability to work independently and stay productive without constant supervision



## Compensation



Base salary based on experience.



This position also includes the opportunity to earn **performance based sales bonuses/commission** based on results.





## How to Apply



Please complete our application here:







As part of the application, you will be asked to submit a short recording and answer questions about your previous sales experience.



**Please do not apply if your experience is primarily customer service, administrative VA work, or appointment setting without personally closing sales.**



We are looking for someone who genuinely enjoys selling, likes talking to people, and gets satisfaction from turning an interested prospect into a booked customer.
